title: 第一次参加读书会
subtitle: At the reading club
goal: 用 be 动词介绍姓名、身份和来自哪里，并区分陈述句与问句。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Maya. Is this the reading club?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我叫玛雅。这里是读书会吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. I'm Leo, the organiser.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我是利奥，活动组织者。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. I'm new here.
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。我是新来的。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Welcome! Are you a student?
dialogue.zh: 欢迎！你是学生吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: No, I'm not. I'm a designer from Hong Kong.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不是。我是一名来自香港的设计师。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Great. The other members are in the next room.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。其他成员在隔壁房间。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'm a little nervous.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我有一点紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: That's OK. Everyone is friendly.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。大家都很友善。

vocab.example: The club is small.
My name is Maya.
I am a student.
Leo is new here.
Maya is from Hong Kong.
The room is quiet.
I am nervous today.
The members are friendly.

grammar.title: be 动词：am、is、are
grammar.rule: be 表示身份、状态或位置。I 用 am；he、she、it 和单数名词用 is；you、we、they 和复数名词用 are。一般疑问句把 be 移到主语前，否定句在 be 后加 not。
grammar.formula: I am… / She is… / They are…；Are you…?；I am not…

examples.en: I am a designer.
Are the members friendly?
She is not a student.

grammar.pitfall: 介绍职业时通常要有冠词：I am a designer，不能说 I am designer。be 问句不需要再加 do。

patterns.en: I am from Hong Kong.
Are you new here?
Nice to meet you.

exercises.prompt: 选择正确句子。
exercises.explanation: 主语 I 与 am 搭配。

exercises.prompt: Maya and Leo ___ in the club.
exercises.explanation: 两个人作主语，表示复数，用 are。

exercises.prompt: 回答 Are you a student?，哪项正确？
exercises.explanation: 用 be 提问，简短回答也用 be；I 对应 am。

exercises.prompt: She ___ from Hong Kong.
exercises.explanation: she 是第三人称单数，be 用 is。

exercises.prompt: 用 am、is 或 are 补空：I ___ a little nervous.
exercises.explanation: I 的 be 动词形式是 am。

exercises.prompt: 用 be 的一般现在时形式补空：___ you the organiser?
exercises.explanation: be 的一般疑问句把 are 放到 you 前。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词，使句子表示否定：He is ___ a student.
exercises.explanation: be 后加 not 构成否定。

exercises.prompt: 把 we are 写成一个缩写形式：___
exercises.explanation: we are 缩写为 we're，撇号替代被省略的 a。

title: 在咖啡店找东西
subtitle: At a café
goal: 用 a、an、the 指认物品，理解第一次提到与特指的区别。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: There is a bag on this chair.
dialogue.zh: 这把椅子上有一个包。

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is it a black bag?
dialogue.zh: 它是一个黑色的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. There is an umbrella beside it, too.
dialogue.zh: 是的。旁边还有一把伞。

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: The bag is mine, but the umbrella isn't.
dialogue.zh: 这个包是我的，但那把伞不是。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Here is your bag. Is this an old notebook?
dialogue.zh: 你的包在这里。这是一本旧笔记本吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. The notebook is for my English lessons.
dialogue.zh: 是的。这本笔记本是我上英语课用的。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: There is a cup near your notebook. Is it yours?
dialogue.zh: 你的笔记本旁边有个杯子。是你的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: No. My cup is on the table by the window.
dialogue.zh: 不是。我的杯子在窗边的桌上。

vocab.example: This is a black bag.
The chair is empty.
An umbrella is beside the door.
The notebook is on the table.
I have a blue cup.
The table is near the window.
The window is open.
This is an old photo.

grammar.title: 冠词 a、an 与 the
grammar.rule: 第一次提到一个不特定的可数单数物品，通常用 a 或 an；以辅音音素开头用 a，以元音音素开头用 an。再次提到或双方知道是哪一个时，通常用 the。判断 a/an 看发音，不看字母。
grammar.formula: a bag / an umbrella；I have a notebook. The notebook is blue.

examples.en: It is an old notebook.
I have a cup. The cup is blue.
examples.zh: 我有一个杯子。这个杯子是蓝色的。

examples.en: She is a university student.

grammar.pitfall: a/an 取决于紧随其后的发音：an old bag，但 a new bag。university 以 /j/ 辅音音素开头，所以是 a university。

patterns.en: Is this your bag?
It is an old notebook.
The cup is on the table.

exercises.prompt: It is ___ umbrella.
exercises.explanation: umbrella 的第一个音是元音音素 /ʌ/，所以用 an。

exercises.prompt: I have a notebook. ___ notebook is blue.
exercises.explanation: 第二次提到同一本笔记本，用 the 特指。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确短语。
exercises.explanation: old 以元音音素开头；new 和 black 均以辅音音素开头。

exercises.prompt: She is ___ university student.
exercises.explanation: university 的开头发音为 /j/，是辅音音素，用 a。

exercises.prompt: 用 a 或 an 补空：This is ___ cup.
exercises.explanation: cup 以辅音音素 /k/ 开头，用 a。

exercises.prompt: 用 a 或 an 补空：It is ___ old table.
exercises.explanation: 紧随冠词的 old 以元音音素开头，用 an。

exercises.prompt: 补出表示再次特指的冠词：I can see a bag. ___ bag is red.
exercises.explanation: 第二次提及同一个包用 the。

exercises.prompt: 写出 umbrella 的中文含义，用一个字：___
exercises.explanation: umbrella 是伞，通常指雨伞。

title: 分清大家的行李
subtitle: Whose suitcase is this?
goal: 区分人称代词、形容词性物主代词和名词性物主代词。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Our suitcases look very similar.
dialogue.zh: 我们的行李箱看起来很相似。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Yes. My suitcase has a green label.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。我的行李箱上有一张绿色标签。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Is the small blue one yours?
dialogue.zh: 那个蓝色的小箱子是你的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: No, it is hers. Emma is by the door.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是她的。艾玛在门旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: That's right. My keys are in its front pocket.
dialogue.zh: 没错。我的钥匙在它前面的口袋里。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Owen, your phone is on my suitcase.
dialogue.zh: 欧文，你的手机在我的行李箱上。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Thanks. Where is yours?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。你的手机在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: It is in my hand!
dialogue.zh: 就在我手里！

vocab.example: Her suitcase is blue.
My bag has a green label.
Your key is on the desk.
The ticket is in my pocket.
His phone is new.
The key is in her hand.
Our bags are similar.
The front pocket is open.

grammar.title: my bag 与 mine
grammar.rule: I、you、he、she、it、we、they 常作主语。my、your、his、her、its、our、their 后面接名词；mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs 可以直接代替“某人的东西”。its 表示“它的”，it's 表示 it is 或 it has。
grammar.formula: This is my bag. = This bag is mine.；Her phone is here. = Hers is here.

examples.en: They are our friends.
Is this suitcase yours?
The bag has a label on its handle.
examples.zh: 这个包的提手上有一张标签。

grammar.pitfall: 不要说 mine bag，应说 my bag；不要在 yours、hers 等词中加撇号。its 是物主形式，不是 it's。

patterns.en: Is this suitcase yours?
My keys are in my pocket.
The blue bag is hers.

exercises.prompt: This is ___ phone.
exercises.explanation: 空格后有名词 phone，应用形容词性物主代词 my。

exercises.prompt: This suitcase belongs to Emma. It is ___.
exercises.explanation: hers 可独立表示“她的东西”；her 后通常还要接名词。

exercises.prompt: ___ are our friends.
exercises.explanation: 此处需要作主语的人称代词 They。

exercises.prompt: 选择“包的口袋”的正确表达。
exercises.explanation: its 表示“它的”；it's 是 it is 或 it has 的缩写。

exercises.prompt: 把 my bag 换成一个词：This bag is ___.
exercises.explanation: mine 独立代替 my bag。

exercises.prompt: 补空：This is your key. The key is ___.
exercises.explanation: yours 代替 your key。

exercises.prompt: 补空：We have a room. It is ___ room.
exercises.explanation: we 的形容词性物主代词是 our。

exercises.prompt: 补空：He has a phone. It is ___ phone.
exercises.explanation: he 的形容词性物主代词是 his。

title: 为野餐准备食物
subtitle: Packing for a picnic
goal: 理解可数名词单复数，并掌握常见复数变化。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: How many people are coming to the picnic?
dialogue.zh: 有多少人来野餐？

dialogue.speaker: Beth
dialogue.en: Six adults and two children.
dialogue.zh: 六个大人和两个孩子。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: We have eight plates, but only five forks.
dialogue.zh: 我们有八个盘子，但只有五把叉子。

dialogue.speaker: Beth
dialogue.en: I have three more forks in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 我包里还有三把叉子。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Great. There are two boxes of sandwiches.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。有两盒三明治。

dialogue.speaker: Beth
dialogue.en: And I have six tomatoes and four peaches.
dialogue.zh: 我还有六个番茄和四个桃子。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Are those bottles of water for us?
dialogue.zh: 那些瓶装水是给我们的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Beth
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's put everything in the baskets.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我们把所有东西放进篮子里吧。

vocab.example: We have a picnic on Sunday.
Two adults are in the kitchen.
The child has a small plate.
We need eight plates.
There are three forks on the table.
The sandwiches are in two boxes.
I have three tomatoes.
Two bottles are in the basket.

grammar.title: 可数名词的复数
grammar.rule: 多数名词加 -s；以 -s、-x、-ch、-sh 等结尾通常加 -es；辅音字母加 y 结尾通常把 y 变 i 再加 -es。部分名词不规则，如 child → children、person → people。
grammar.formula: plate → plates；box → boxes；city → cities；child → children

examples.en: There are two boxes.
Three children are at the picnic.
We need four bottles of water.

grammar.pitfall: people 本身通常表示复数，不要用 two person。tomato 的复数是 tomatoes，但不能据此认为所有 -o 结尾的词都加 -es，例如 photos。

patterns.en: How many people are coming?
We need three more forks.
There are two boxes of sandwiches.

exercises.prompt: box 的复数形式是？
exercises.explanation: box 以 -x 结尾，复数加 -es。

exercises.prompt: There are two ___ in the park.
exercises.explanation: child 的不规则复数是 children。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的数量表达。
exercises.explanation: tomato 的复数是 tomatoes。

exercises.prompt: city 的复数形式是？
exercises.explanation: city 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 后加 -es。

exercises.prompt: 写出 plate 的复数：___
exercises.explanation: 大多数可数名词的复数直接加 -s。

exercises.prompt: 写出 bottle 的复数：___
exercises.explanation: bottle 的复数是在词尾加 -s。

exercises.prompt: 用 person 的复数补空：One person is here. Six ___ are outside.
exercises.explanation: 普通日常语境一般用 people；正式或法律等语境也可见 persons，本题也接受。

exercises.prompt: 写出 sandwich 的复数：___
exercises.explanation: sandwich 以 -ch 结尾，复数加 -es。

title: 参观共享办公室
subtitle: A tour of the workspace
goal: 描述某处有什么，并用位置介词说明摆放。

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Welcome to the workspace. There is a quiet room on the left.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到共享办公室。左边有一间安静室。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Is there a desk near the window?
dialogue.zh: 窗边有书桌吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Yes. There are two desks beside the window.
dialogue.zh: 有。窗边有两张书桌。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Where is the printer?
dialogue.zh: 打印机在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: It is between the door and the cupboard.
dialogue.zh: 它在门和柜子之间。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: And where can I put my coat?
dialogue.zh: 那我可以把外套放在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: There are hooks behind the door.
dialogue.zh: 门后面有挂钩。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Perfect. There isn't much noise here.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。这里没什么噪声。

vocab.example: There is a desk near the window.
The printer is beside the cupboard.
The paper is in the cupboard.
My coat is behind the door.
The bag is behind the chair.
The desk is between two windows.
The café is near the station.
This is a quiet room.

grammar.title: there is / there are 与位置介词
grammar.rule: there is 表示某处有一个可数单数事物，或有不可数事物；there are 后接可数复数。问句将 is/are 放在 there 前。in 在里面，on 在表面，under 在下面，behind 在后面，between… and… 在两者之间。
grammar.formula: There is + 单数名词 + 地点.；There are + 复数名词 + 地点.；Is there…?

examples.en: There is a printer near the door.
There are two coats behind the door.
The desk is between the window and the cupboard.
examples.zh: 书桌在窗户和柜子之间。

grammar.pitfall: there be 表示“存在”，have 表示“拥有”。不要说 There have two desks。问“打印机在哪里”用 Where is the printer?。

patterns.en: Is there a quiet room?
The printer is near the door.
There are two desks by the window.

exercises.prompt: There ___ a printer in the room.
exercises.explanation: 后面的 a printer 是单数，所以用 there is。

exercises.prompt: There ___ three chairs near the desk.
exercises.explanation: three chairs 是复数，用 there are。

exercises.prompt: “在门后面”的正确表达是？
exercises.explanation: behind 表示在……后面。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的一般疑问句。
exercises.explanation: there is 的一般疑问句将 is 放到 there 前。

exercises.prompt: 补空：The printer is between the door ___ the cupboard.
exercises.explanation: 表示两者之间用 between A and B。

exercises.prompt: 用 be 的一般现在时形式补空：There ___ not any desks in this room.
exercises.explanation: desks 是复数，因此 be 用 are。

exercises.prompt: 从 in / on / under 中选词，表示“在……里面”：The paper is ___ the cupboard.
exercises.explanation: in 表示在一个空间或容器里面。

exercises.prompt: 从 in / on / under 中选词，表示“在……下面”：The bag is ___ the desk.
exercises.explanation: under 表示在……下面。

title: 安排一个工作日
subtitle: My weekday routine
goal: 用一般现在时描述 I、you、we、they 的习惯及稳定情况。

dialogue.speaker: Ruth
dialogue.en: I work from home on Mondays. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 我星期一在家工作。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I go to the office, but I start at ten.
dialogue.zh: 我去办公室，不过我十点开始工作。

dialogue.speaker: Ruth
dialogue.en: I usually start at nine and take a break at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 我通常九点开始工作，十一点休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: We have lunch together at one in our office.
dialogue.zh: 我们办公室里的人一点一起吃午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Ruth
dialogue.en: I cook lunch at home. I don't buy lunch on weekdays.
dialogue.zh: 我在家做午饭。工作日我不买午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I walk home after work. The walk helps me relax.
dialogue.zh: 我下班后走路回家。走路能让我放松。

dialogue.speaker: Ruth
dialogue.en: My neighbours and I exercise in the park after dinner.
dialogue.zh: 晚饭后，我和邻居们在公园锻炼。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: That sounds good. I read for half an hour before bed.
dialogue.zh: 听起来不错。我睡前读半小时书。

vocab.example: I work from home.
We start at nine.
I take a short break at eleven.
We have lunch at one.
I cook dinner at home.

vocab.meaning: 工作日；周一至周五的日子
vocab.example: I work on weekdays.
They walk to work.
I read before bed.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：习惯与日常
grammar.rule: 一般现在时可描述反复发生的习惯和比较稳定的情况。I、you、we、they 后面的实义动词通常用原形；否定句用 do not 或 don't 加动词原形。
grammar.formula: I / You / We / They + 动词原形；I / You / We / They + do not + 动词原形

examples.en: I work from home on Mondays.
They walk to the office.
We do not buy lunch on weekdays.

grammar.pitfall: 描述习惯的实义动词前不要随意加 be：I work，不能说 I am work。I am working 表示另一种结构，通常描述正在进行的动作。

patterns.en: I start work at nine.
We have lunch together.
I don't buy lunch on weekdays.

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的习惯表达。
exercises.explanation: I 后用动词原形 work，描述日常习惯时不加 am。

exercises.prompt: They ___ to the office every day.
exercises.explanation: they 是复数主语，一般现在时用动词原形。

exercises.prompt: We ___ lunch at home on weekdays.
exercises.explanation: we 的一般现在时否定句用 don't 加动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 哪句主要描述反复发生的习惯？
options: I walk to work every Monday.
I am walking to work now.
I will walk to work tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I walk to work every Monday.
exercises.explanation: every Monday 表示每周一反复发生的动作，搭配一般现在时。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用 work 的正确形式补空：I ___ in a small office.
exercises.explanation: 主语 I 后面用动词原形 work。

exercises.prompt: 补出一般现在时否定句的助动词：We ___ not eat lunch at our desks.
exercises.explanation: we 的实义动词否定句用 do not。

exercises.prompt: 用 read 的正确形式补空：They ___ before bed every night.
exercises.explanation: 主语 they 后用一般现在时原形 read。

exercises.prompt: 用 cook 的正确形式补空：You don't ___ on Fridays.
exercises.explanation: 助动词 don't 后的实义动词用原形。

title: 朋友的新工作
subtitle: A new job at the museum
goal: 掌握第三人称单数的动词变化，并在否定句恢复原形。

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: My sister has a new job at the museum.
dialogue.zh: 我姐姐在博物馆找到了一份新工作。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: What does she do there?
dialogue.zh: 她在那里做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: She teaches children about local history.
dialogue.zh: 她教孩子们了解当地历史。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Does she work at weekends?
dialogue.zh: 她周末工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: Yes. She works on Saturdays, but she doesn't work on Mondays.
dialogue.zh: 是的。她星期六工作，但星期一不工作。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: How does she travel to the museum?
dialogue.zh: 她怎么去博物馆？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: She takes the bus. It stops outside the main entrance.
dialogue.zh: 她乘巴士。巴士在正门外停车。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: That is convenient. She seems happy in her new job.
dialogue.zh: 那很方便。她对这份新工作似乎很满意。

vocab.example: The museum opens at ten.
She teaches history.
He studies local history.
The museum has local photographs.
She travels by bus.
The bus stops here.
The entrance is on the left.
Her new job starts on Monday.

grammar.title: he / she / it 后的动词
grammar.rule: 一般现在时肯定句中，he、she、it 或单数名词后，动词通常加 -s；-ch、-sh、-s、-x 等结尾常加 -es；辅音字母加 y 结尾通常变为 -ies。have 变 has，do 变 does，go 变 goes。否定句用 doesn't 加原形。
grammar.formula: She works / teaches / studies.；She has…；She does not work.

examples.en: He studies local history.
The bus stops outside the museum.
She does not work on Mondays.

grammar.pitfall: 第三人称变化只需承担一次：She doesn't work，不是 She doesn't works。元音字母加 y 通常直接加 -s，例如 play → plays。

patterns.en: She works at a museum.
He takes the bus to work.
She doesn't work on Mondays.

exercises.prompt: My sister ___ children at the museum.
exercises.explanation: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，teach 以 -ch 结尾，加 -es。

exercises.prompt: He ___ a new job.
exercises.explanation: have 的第三人称单数形式是 has。

exercises.prompt: She doesn't ___ on Mondays.
exercises.explanation: doesn't 后面的动词使用原形。

exercises.prompt: play 的第三人称单数形式是？
exercises.explanation: play 的 y 前是元音字母 a，所以直接加 -s。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用 study 的正确形式补空：He ___ history every evening.
exercises.explanation: study 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用 go 的正确形式补空：She ___ to the museum by bus.
exercises.explanation: go 的第三人称单数形式是 goes。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用 stop 的正确形式补空：The bus ___ outside the entrance.
exercises.explanation: 一般现在时第三人称单数在 stop 后加 -s。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词，使句子表示否定：He does ___ work on Sundays.
exercises.explanation: does 后加 not 构成否定，后面的 work 保持原形。

title: 找一个合适的健身班
subtitle: Choosing an exercise class
goal: 用 do/does 提问日常情况，并作准确的简短回答。

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.en: Do you exercise regularly?
dialogue.zh: 你经常锻炼吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Yes, I do. I swim twice a week.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我每周游泳两次。

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.en: Does your friend exercise with you?
dialogue.zh: 你的朋友和你一起锻炼吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: No, he doesn't. He prefers cycling.
dialogue.zh: 不，他不和我一起。他更喜欢骑车。

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.en: What time do you finish work?
dialogue.zh: 你几点下班？

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: I finish at six. Do you have any evening classes?
dialogue.zh: 我六点下班。你们有晚间课程吗？

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.en: Yes, we do. The beginner class starts at seven.
dialogue.zh: 有的。初学者班七点开始。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Great. How much does it cost?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。费用是多少？

vocab.example: I exercise twice a week.
Do you swim on Sundays?
We meet twice a week.
The course starts next week.
My friend enjoys cycling.
I finish work at six.
The class is in the evening.
How much does the class cost?

grammar.title: 实义动词的一般现在时问句
grammar.rule: 主语为 I、you、we、they 时用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形；主语为 he、she、it 或单数名词时用 Does。特殊疑问词放在 do/does 前。简短回答使用相应的 do/does。
grammar.formula: Do you swim? — Yes, I do.；Does he swim? — No, he does not.；When does he finish?

examples.en: Do they exercise here?
Does the class start at seven?
What time do you finish work?

grammar.pitfall: Does 后面的主要动词不加 -s：Does she swim?；be 问句则直接用 Is/Are，如 Are you ready?，不要说 Do you are ready?。

patterns.en: Do you have any evening classes?
What time do you finish work?
How much does it cost?

exercises.prompt: ___ your friend swim every week?
exercises.explanation: your friend 是单数，实义动词 swim 的问句用 Does。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确问句。
exercises.explanation: she 对应 Does，后面的 like 使用原形。

exercises.prompt: 回答 Do you exercise here?，哪项正确？
exercises.explanation: do 提问的简短肯定回答为 Yes, I do。

exercises.prompt: “你准备好了吗？”的正确表达是？
exercises.explanation: ready 是形容词，应用 Are you ready?；be 直接放在主语前，不需要 do。

exercises.prompt: 用 do 或 does 补空：___ they have classes on Fridays?
exercises.explanation: they 的一般现在时实义动词问句用 Do。

exercises.prompt: 用 start 的正确形式补空：What time does the class ___?
exercises.explanation: does 已承担第三人称变化，start 用原形。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：Does he cycle to work? — No, he ___.（用缩写）
exercises.explanation: does 提问的否定回答使用 doesn't。

exercises.prompt: 用 do 或 does 补空：How much ___ the course cost?
exercises.explanation: the course 是单数，特殊疑问句用 does 加动词原形 cost。

title: 让练习变成习惯
subtitle: Small habits, steady progress
goal: 正确放置频率副词，并用次数描述规律。

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.en: When do you practise English?
dialogue.zh: 你什么时候练习英语？

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: I usually read a short article on the train.
dialogue.zh: 我通常在火车上读一篇短文章。

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.en: Do you listen to English every day?
dialogue.zh: 你每天都听英语吗？

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: Not every day. I sometimes listen to a podcast at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 不是每天。我有时午饭时听播客。

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.en: How often do you speak English?
dialogue.zh: 你多久说一次英语？

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: I speak with a friend twice a week, but I am often nervous.
dialogue.zh: 我每周和朋友说两次，但我经常紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.en: That is normal. I always keep my practice sessions short.
dialogue.zh: 这很正常。我总是把每次练习控制得短一些。

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.en: Good idea. I never feel tired after five minutes of practice.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。练习五分钟后，我从来不会觉得累。

vocab.example: I always check my answers.
She usually reads on the train.
We often practise together.
I sometimes listen at lunch.
He never skips breakfast.
I read a short article.
We practise English together.
I am sometimes tired after work.

grammar.title: 频率副词与 how often
grammar.rule: always、usually、often、sometimes、never 表示频率。它们通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。how often 用来询问频率；once a week、twice a week 等常放在句尾。sometimes 也可自然地放在句首或句尾。
grammar.formula: I usually read.；I am often nervous.；How often…? — Twice a week.

examples.en: She often listens to podcasts.
He is never late.
We practise three times a week.

grammar.pitfall: never 已经含有否定意义，标准表达通常不再加 don't：I never skip breakfast。不要把频率副词解释成固定百分比。

patterns.en: How often do you practise?
I usually read on the train.
We practise twice a week.

exercises.prompt: 用 often 描述阅读习惯，选择正确语序。
exercises.explanation: 频率副词 often 通常在实义动词 read 前。

exercises.prompt: 用 usually 描述状态，选择正确语序。
exercises.explanation: 频率副词 usually 通常位于 be 动词 is 后。

exercises.prompt: 想问练习频率，应该说？
exercises.explanation: how often 专门询问事情发生的频率。

exercises.prompt: “每周两次”的表达是？
exercises.explanation: twice 表示两次；a week 表示每周。

exercises.prompt: 用表示“从不”的一个词补空：I ___ skip breakfast.
exercises.explanation: never 表示从不，本身已有否定含义。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：We practise three ___ a week.
exercises.explanation: 三次及以上用数字加 times。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：How ___ does she read English articles?（询问频率）
exercises.explanation: how often 表示多久一次。

exercises.prompt: 用表示“一次”的一个词补空：I attend the club ___ a week.
exercises.explanation: once a week 表示每周一次。

title: 一起组织社区活动
subtitle: Helping at a community event
goal: 用 can 说明能力、提出请求，并掌握否定与疑问形式。

dialogue.speaker: Jo
dialogue.en: We need help with Saturday's community event.
dialogue.zh: 我们星期六的社区活动需要人帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I can make posters. Can I help with those?
dialogue.zh: 我会做海报。我可以帮忙做海报吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jo
dialogue.en: Of course. Can you add the address and the start time?
dialogue.zh: 当然。你能把地址和开始时间加上去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Yes, I can. Can anyone translate the poster into Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 可以。有人能把海报翻译成中文吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jo
dialogue.en: Mei can. She can speak both Chinese and English.
dialogue.zh: 梅可以。她会说中文和英语。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Great. I can't carry the heavy tables on my own.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那些重桌子我一个人搬不动。

dialogue.speaker: Jo
dialogue.en: I can help you. Please leave the tables here for now.
dialogue.zh: 我可以帮你。请先把桌子放在这里。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Thanks. We can finish everything before lunch.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我们能在午饭前把事情全部做完。

vocab.example: Can you help me?
I can make a poster.
Please add the address.
She can translate this sentence.
He can speak English.
Can you carry this box?
The table is heavy.
The event starts at ten.

grammar.title: 情态动词 can
grammar.rule: can 后接动词原形，不随主语变化。它可以表示能力，也可以用于请求帮助或询问许可。否定形式是 cannot 或 can't；疑问句把 can 放在主语前。
grammar.formula: She can speak…；She cannot speak…；Can you help…? — Yes, I can.

examples.en: Mei can translate the poster.
Can you carry this table?
I cannot finish it on my own.

grammar.pitfall: can 后不加 to，也不加第三人称 -s：She can speak，不能说 She can speaks 或 She can to speak。否定完整形式通常写成一个词 cannot。

patterns.en: Can you help me with this?
I can do it on my own.
Can I leave this here?
patterns.zh: 我可以把这个放在这里吗？

exercises.prompt: 选择正确句子。
exercises.explanation: can 不变形，后接动词原形 speak。

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks for help?（哪句是在请求帮助？）
exercises.explanation: Can you…? 可用于请求对方做某事。

exercises.prompt: 回答 Can Mei translate this?，哪项正确？
exercises.explanation: can 提问的简短回答也使用 can。

exercises.prompt: can 的完整否定形式通常写作？
exercises.explanation: 标准完整否定形式通常写成一个词 cannot。

exercises.prompt: 用 carry 的正确形式补空：He can ___ the heavy box.
exercises.explanation: can 后用动词原形 carry。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：___ you help me with the poster?（用 can 提出请求）
exercises.explanation: 请求句 Can you…? 把 can 放在主语前。

exercises.prompt: 用 can 的缩写否定形式补空：I ___ finish this on my own.
exercises.explanation: can 的缩写否定形式是 can't。

exercises.prompt: 用 speak 的正确形式补空：Can she ___ Chinese?
exercises.explanation: can 问句中的主要动词仍用原形。

title: 给访客指路
subtitle: Finding the community garden
goal: 用动词原形给指示，以 don’t 表达禁止，并说明简单路线。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Excuse me. How can I get to the community garden?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思。去社区花园怎么走？

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.en: Go straight along this street, then turn left at the library.
dialogue.zh: 沿着这条街一直走，然后在图书馆左转。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Do I cross the main road?
dialogue.zh: 我要穿过主干道吗？

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.en: Yes. Use the crossing, and wait for the green light.
dialogue.zh: 要。请走行人过路处，并等绿灯。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: What should I look for after that?
dialogue.zh: 之后我应该找什么？

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.en: Look for a small gate on your right. Don't enter the car park.
dialogue.zh: 留意右边的一扇小门。不要进入停车场。

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.en: Is the garden open now?
dialogue.zh: 花园现在开放吗？

dialogue.speaker: Resident
dialogue.en: Yes. Please close the gate behind you.
dialogue.zh: 开放。进去后请把门关好。

vocab.example: Go straight along this street.
Turn left at the library.
The gate is on your left.
Turn right after the bridge.
Cross the road carefully.
Please close the gate.
Close the door, please.
Wait for the green light.

grammar.title: 祈使句：说明、提醒与请求
grammar.rule: 祈使句通常省略主语 you，直接以动词原形开头。否定指令用 Do not 或 Don't 加动词原形。加入 please 可以使请求更礼貌。
grammar.formula: Turn left.；Please wait.；Do not enter.；Don't cross here.

examples.en: Go straight along this street.
Please close the gate.
Do not enter the car park.

grammar.pitfall: 不要在祈使句的动词后加第三人称 -s：Turn left，不是 Turns left。wait for 表示等待；look for 表示寻找，两者都常需 for。

patterns.en: Go straight, then turn left.
Wait for the green light.
Please close the gate behind you.

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的指路句。
options: To turn left at the library.
exercises.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形 Turn 开头。

exercises.prompt: “不要进入”应说？
exercises.explanation: 否定祈使句用 Don't 加动词原形。

exercises.prompt: “在你的右边”应说？
exercises.explanation: 表示在某人的右边常用 on your right。

exercises.prompt: 哪句是礼貌请求？
exercises.explanation: please 后接完整祈使句，主要动词用原形 close。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：Wait ___ the green light.
exercises.explanation: wait for 表示等待某人或某物。

exercises.prompt: 用 turn 的正确形式补空：___ right at the next street.
exercises.explanation: 指路祈使句以动词原形开头。

exercises.prompt: 用表示“寻找”的短语 look for 补一个词：Look ___ a small gate on your right.
exercises.explanation: look for 表示寻找。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词，把句子变成禁止：Do ___ enter this room.
exercises.explanation: Do not 加动词原形构成否定祈使句。

title: 买齐一顿晚饭的材料
subtitle: Shopping for dinner
theme: 可数与不可数；how much / many
goal: 区分食物名词的可数性，并询问数量与价格。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: I'd like some rice and a few vegetables, please.
dialogue.zh: 我想要一些米和一些蔬菜，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.en: How much rice do you need?
dialogue.zh: 你需要多少米？

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: One kilo, please. How many carrots are in this bag?
dialogue.zh: 一公斤，谢谢。这袋里有多少根胡萝卜？

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.en: There are six. Do you need any milk?
dialogue.zh: 有六根。你需要牛奶吗？

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Yes, one bottle. I don't need any bread today.
dialogue.zh: 需要，一瓶。我今天不需要面包。

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.en: Is there anything else?
dialogue.zh: 还需要什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: No, thank you. How much is everything?
dialogue.zh: 不用了，谢谢。一共多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.en: It's twelve pounds. Here is your receipt.
dialogue.zh: 十二英镑。这是你的收据。

vocab.example: We need some rice.
I buy fresh vegetables.
There are six carrots in the bag.
We have a bottle of milk.
I need two slices of bread.
One kilo of rice is enough.
The milk is two pounds.
Please keep your receipt.

grammar.title: how many、how much、some 与 any
grammar.rule: how many 后接可数复数，how much 后接不可数名词。询问价格也用 how much。some 常用于肯定句，any 常用于疑问句和否定句。不可数名词可用单位计量，如 a bottle of milk、two slices of bread。
grammar.formula: How many carrots…?；How much rice…?；How much is it?；some milk / not any milk

examples.en: How many carrots do we need?
examples.zh: 我们需要多少根胡萝卜？

examples.en: How much rice do you want?
We do not need any bread.

grammar.pitfall: 通常不能说 two breads 或 a rice，应用 two slices of bread、a bowl of rice 等。some/any 的规则并非绝对；邀请或请求时常用 some，例如 Would you like some tea?。

patterns.en: How much rice do you need?
How many carrots are in the bag?
patterns.zh: 袋子里有多少根胡萝卜？

patterns.en: How much is everything?

exercises.prompt: How ___ carrots do we need?
exercises.explanation: carrots 是可数复数，询问数量用 how many。

exercises.prompt: How ___ milk is in the bottle?
exercises.explanation: milk 通常不可数，询问数量用 how much。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的表达。
exercises.explanation: bread 通常不可数；通过 slices 计量，two 后用复数 slices。

exercises.prompt: 想问总价，应说？
exercises.explanation: 问价格用 how much；everything 作单数，be 用 is。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：We don't need ___ milk.（some / any）
exercises.explanation: 一般否定句常用 any。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：I would like ___ rice, please.（some / any）
exercises.explanation: 表示想要一些米，这个肯定陈述中用 some。

exercises.prompt: 补一个词：two bottles ___ milk
exercises.explanation: 用“容器或单位 + of + 物品”表示数量。

exercises.prompt: 用 much 或 many 补空：How ___ bread do you need?
exercises.explanation: bread 通常不可数，因此用 how much。

title: 此刻正在做什么
subtitle: The Studio Is Busy
goal: 用 am / is / are + -ing 描述眼前正在发生的事情，并询问别人正在做什么。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, Leo. What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，利奥。你正在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I am painting a small sign for our studio.
dialogue.zh: 我正在为我们的工作室画一块小招牌。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Is Nora helping you?
dialogue.zh: 诺拉正在帮你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: No, she is taking photos by the window.
dialogue.zh: 没有，她正在窗边拍照。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The visitors are waiting outside.
dialogue.zh: 参观者们正在外面等候。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: All right, I am opening the door now!
dialogue.zh: 好，我现在正在开门！

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Great. I am bringing them some water.
dialogue.zh: 好。我正在给他们拿水。

vocab.example: She is painting a blue door.
The sign says “Welcome”.
Our studio has two windows.
I am taking a photo of the garden.
Please open the window.
A visitor is waiting at the door.
We are waiting for the bus.
Can you bring some water?

grammar.title: 现在进行时：正在发生的动作
grammar.rule: 用现在进行时表示说话时正在发生的动作。be 动词随主语变化：I am，he/she/it is，you/we/they are。否定在 be 后加 not；疑问句把 be 移到主语前。动词一般加 -ing；以不发音的 e 结尾通常去 e 再加 -ing，如 take → taking。 部分重读闭音节动词需双写末尾辅音，如 run → running。
grammar.formula: 主语 + am / is / are + 动词-ing；Am / Is / Are + 主语 + 动词-ing?

examples.en: I am writing a message.
They are not watching the screen.
Is she making tea?

grammar.pitfall: 不能漏掉 be：I painting 错，应为 I am painting。take 的 -ing 形式是 taking，不是 takeing。

patterns.en: What are you doing?
I am working on a new idea.
patterns.zh: 我正在构思一个新点子。

patterns.en: Are they waiting for us?

exercises.prompt: 看着眼前的场景：She ___ a photo now.
exercises.explanation: now 与眼前正在发生的动作对应现在进行时；she 搭配 is。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的现在进行时问句。
exercises.explanation: 现在进行时疑问句将 are 放在 you 前，实义动词用 listening。

exercises.prompt: They ___ outside at the moment.
exercises.explanation: they 用 are；at the moment 表示此刻。

exercises.prompt: take 的 -ing 形式是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: take 以不发音的 e 结尾，去 e 加 -ing。

exercises.prompt: 填入 be 动词：I ___ opening the window now.
exercises.explanation: 主语 I 的现在时 be 动词是 am。

exercises.prompt: 填入 be 动词：The visitors ___ looking at the sign now.
exercises.explanation: visitors 是复数，使用 are。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的 -ing 形式填空：Nora is ___ (write) a note.
exercises.explanation: write 去掉不发音的 e，再加 -ing。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的 -ing 形式填空：We are ___ (wait) for Leo.
exercises.explanation: wait 直接加 -ing，得到 waiting。

title: 每天如此，今天不同
subtitle: A Different Morning
theme: 一般现在时与现在进行时
goal: 区分规律、习惯与当前或暂时的活动，用 usually 和 today 说明变化。

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.en: You usually cycle to work. Why are you walking today?
dialogue.zh: 你通常骑车上班。今天为什么走路？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: My bike is at the repair shop, so I am walking this week.
dialogue.zh: 我的自行车在维修店，所以这周我步行。

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.en: Does your brother still work at the library?
dialogue.zh: 你哥哥还在图书馆工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, he does. He starts at nine every weekday.
dialogue.zh: 是的。他每个工作日上午九点开始上班。

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.en: Is he working there today?
dialogue.zh: 他今天正在那里工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: No, he is studying at home today. He has a day off.
dialogue.zh: 没有，他今天在家学习。他今天休假。

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.en: I see. I usually study in the evening, but I am reading on the train now.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我通常晚上学习，但我现在正在火车上看书。

vocab.example: I usually have lunch at noon.
She cycles to college.
My phone needs a repair.
The library opens at ten.
I work every weekday.
He is studying English today.
We read in the evening.
They are waiting for a train.

grammar.title: 习惯与此刻：两个现在时
grammar.rule: 一般现在时描述习惯或相对稳定的情况；现在进行时描述正在发生或暂时的活动。usually、every day 常用于习惯；now、at the moment 常用于正在发生的事。时间词只是线索，要根据实际意思判断。
grammar.formula: 习惯：主语 + 动词原形 / 第三人称单数；当前活动：主语 + am / is / are + 动词-ing

examples.en: He works in a library.
He is working at home this week.
I usually walk, but I am taking the bus today.
examples.zh: 我通常步行，但今天坐公共汽车。

grammar.pitfall: 主语是 he/she/it 时，一般现在时肯定句的动词通常加 -s；现在进行时要用 is + -ing，不能写 he is works。

patterns.en: I usually walk to work.
Today I am taking the train.
What do you usually do in the evening?

exercises.prompt: 表达日常习惯：Ben ___ to work every weekday.
exercises.explanation: every weekday 说明日常习惯，Ben 为第三人称单数，使用 cycles。

exercises.prompt: Look! Ben ___ across the bridge.
exercises.explanation: Look! 引出眼前正在发生的动作，使用 is walking。

exercises.prompt: 选择表示“她通常在家学习”的句子。
options: She is usually study at home.
exercises.explanation: 习惯使用一般现在时；study 遇第三人称单数，将 y 改为 i 再加 -es。

exercises.prompt: 请选择表示“此刻正在喝”的形式：I usually drink tea, but right now I ___ coffee.
exercises.explanation: right now 强调此刻正在喝，用 am drinking。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用括号内动词的正确形式填空：She usually ___ (start) work at nine.
exercises.explanation: 一般现在时，she 为第三人称单数，start 加 -s。

exercises.prompt: 填入 be 动词：They ___ reading in the library at the moment.
exercises.explanation: they 的 be 动词是 are，构成现在进行时。

exercises.prompt: 填入 do 或 does：___ your brother work here every day?
exercises.explanation: 一般现在时疑问句中，your brother 为第三人称单数，用 does。

exercises.prompt: 请使用一般现在时。用括号内动词的正确形式填空：He usually ___ (study) after dinner.
exercises.explanation: 辅音字母加 y 结尾的 study，第三人称单数变 y 为 i 再加 -es。

title: 昨天的展览
subtitle: At the Exhibition Yesterday
goal: 用 was / were 描述过去的地点、状态和感受，并形成否定句与一般疑问句。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Were you at the design exhibition yesterday?
dialogue.zh: 你昨天在设计展吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Yes, I was. It was much busier than I expected.
dialogue.zh: 是的。那里比我预想的热闹得多。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Was the main hall noisy?
dialogue.zh: 主展厅吵吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: It was noisy near the entrance, but the upstairs room was quiet.
dialogue.zh: 入口附近很吵，但楼上的房间很安静。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Were the tickets expensive?
dialogue.zh: 门票贵吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: No, they were not. The student tickets were only five pounds.
dialogue.zh: 不贵。学生票只要五英镑。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: I was at work all day. I am sorry I missed it.
dialogue.zh: 我昨天一整天都在上班。没去成真遗憾。

vocab.example: I was at home yesterday.
The exhibition was interesting.
The hall was full.
Meet me at the entrance.
The upstairs room was quiet.
The street was noisy.
Our tickets were cheap.
The meal was expensive.

grammar.title: was / were：过去的状态
grammar.rule: be 的过去式为 was 和 were。I/he/she/it 用 was；you/we/they 用 were。否定在 was/were 后加 not；疑问句把 was/were 放在主语前。这里描述的是过去的状态，不需要 did。
grammar.formula: 主语 + was / were + 地点或状态；Was / Were + 主语 + 地点或状态?

examples.en: I was tired yesterday.
The shops were not open.
examples.zh: 那些商店当时没有营业。

examples.en: Was the room quiet?

grammar.pitfall: 不能说 Did you were tired? 应说 Were you tired? was not 可缩写为 wasn’t，were not 可缩写为 weren’t。

patterns.en: Where were you yesterday afternoon?
I was at the exhibition.
Were the tickets expensive?

exercises.prompt: Yesterday, the main hall ___ very busy.
exercises.explanation: yesterday 指过去；the main hall 为单数，使用 was。

exercises.prompt: ___ you at the exhibition last night?
exercises.explanation: 过去的 be 疑问句用 were + you。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的过去时否定句。
options: The tickets did not were expensive.
exercises.explanation: tickets 为复数，使用 were not。

exercises.prompt: “Was Tom tired?” 的肯定简答是：
exercises.explanation: 用 was 提问过去状态，简答也用 was。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：I ___ at work yesterday.
exercises.explanation: I 在过去时中搭配 was。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：The visitors ___ upstairs an hour ago.
exercises.explanation: visitors 为复数，搭配 were。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：___ the entrance easy to find yesterday?
exercises.explanation: entrance 为单数，疑问句用 was 开头。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：We ___ not late for the exhibition.
exercises.explanation: we 在过去时中搭配 were，否定为 were not。

title: 周末修好一座花园
subtitle: A Garden Project
goal: 用规则动词过去式叙述已结束的事情，掌握 -ed 的基本拼写变化。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: How was your weekend?
dialogue.zh: 你的周末怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.en: Great. Our neighbours started a small garden project.
dialogue.zh: 很好。我们的邻居们开展了一个小花园项目。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: What happened first?
dialogue.zh: 最先做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.en: We cleaned the path and painted the old benches.
dialogue.zh: 我们清扫了小路，还给旧长椅刷了漆。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: That sounds useful.
dialogue.zh: 听起来很实用。

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.en: Then we planted some flowers. The children carried the tools.
dialogue.zh: 然后我们种了些花。孩子们搬运了工具。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Was everyone tired afterwards?
dialogue.zh: 之后大家都累了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.en: Yes, but we enjoyed the afternoon and shared some snacks.
dialogue.zh: 是的，但我们度过了愉快的下午，还分享了些零食。

vocab.example: Our neighbour helped us.
We finished the project on Sunday.
They cleaned the path.
We painted a wooden bench.
They planted flowers near the gate.
I carried the tools outside.
Please put the tools in the box.
We shared a large pizza.

grammar.title: 规则过去式：事情已经做完
grammar.rule: 一般过去时可叙述在过去已经结束的动作。规则动词通常加 -ed；以 e 结尾加 -d；辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -ed；部分重读闭音节词双写末尾辅音再加 -ed，如 stop → stopped。 -ed 的发音取决于前一个音：worked 结尾为 /t/，cleaned 为 /d/，painted 为 /ɪd/；/t/ 或 /d/ 后的 -ed 会增加一个音节。
grammar.formula: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他；clean → cleaned；live → lived；carry → carried；stop → stopped

examples.en: We cleaned the garden yesterday.
She carried two bags.
The rain stopped at noon.

grammar.pitfall: 过去式不随主语的人称变化：I worked 和 she worked 都正确。enjoy 的 y 前是元音，直接加 -ed：enjoyed。

patterns.en: First, we cleaned the path.
Then we planted some flowers.
We enjoyed the afternoon.
patterns.zh: 我们度过了愉快的下午。

exercises.prompt: Last Sunday, we ___ the old benches.
exercises.explanation: Last Sunday 表示已经结束的过去时间，使用 painted。

exercises.prompt: carry 的过去式是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: carry 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i，再加 -ed。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确句子。
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时的 helped 不因主语 she 再加 -s。

exercises.prompt: enjoy 的过去式是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: enjoy 的 y 前为元音 o，保留 y，直接加 -ed。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：We ___ (clean) the path yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 规则动词 clean 直接加 -ed。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：She ___ (live) here in 2020.
exercises.explanation: live 以 e 结尾，只加 -d。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：The bus ___ (stop) near the garden.
exercises.explanation: stop 的过去式双写 p，再加 -ed。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：The children ___ (carry) the tools inside.
exercises.explanation: carry 的 y 前为辅音 r，变 y 为 i 再加 -ed。

title: 一次意外的发现
subtitle: The Notebook in the Market
theme: 不规则动词一般过去时
goal: 掌握常用不规则过去式，用先后顺序讲清一件已经发生的小事。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: You look pleased. What happened?
dialogue.zh: 你看起来很高兴。发生什么事了？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: I went to the weekend market and found an old notebook.
dialogue.zh: 我去了周末集市，发现了一本旧笔记本。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: What was special about it?
dialogue.zh: 它有什么特别之处？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: It had drawings of the town from fifty years ago.
dialogue.zh: 里面有五十年前这座城镇的画。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: So you bought it?
dialogue.zh: 所以你买下了它？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: Yes. Then I took it to my grandfather.
dialogue.zh: 是的。然后我把它拿给了我祖父。

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.en: What did he think?
dialogue.zh: 他觉得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.en: He saw the drawings and told me stories about every street.
dialogue.zh: 他看了那些画，给我讲了每条街的故事。

vocab.example: I went to the market on Saturday.
She bought a new notebook.
The drawing shows an old bridge.
We live in a small town.
This photo is special to me.
I found my keys under the chair.
We bought some fruit.
He told us an interesting story.

grammar.title: 不规则过去式：常用动词逐个记
grammar.rule: 一些高频动词的过去式不加 -ed，需要作为词组反复练习，例如 go → went、find → found、buy → bought、take → took、see → saw、tell → told、have → had。肯定句直接使用过去式。
grammar.formula: 主语 + 不规则动词过去式；go → went；buy → bought；see → saw

examples.en: I went to a market.
She bought a notebook.
We saw a drawing of our street.
examples.zh: 我们看到了一幅画着我们那条街的画。

grammar.pitfall: 不要按照规则形式造出 goed、buyed 或 seed（表示 see 的过去式时）。同一段叙述中的动词也可能混用规则和不规则过去式。

patterns.en: I found something interesting.
patterns.zh: 我发现了一件有趣的东西。

patterns.en: Then I took it home.
He told me a story about it.
patterns.zh: 他给我讲了一个关于它的故事。

exercises.prompt: Yesterday, Amir ___ to the market.
exercises.explanation: go 的过去式为 went，不是 goed。

exercises.prompt: buy 的过去式是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: buy 的不规则过去式为 bought。

exercises.prompt: My grandfather ___ the drawings and smiled.
exercises.explanation: 这里叙述过去的动作；see 的过去式为 saw。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确句子。
options: She told me a story last night.
She telled me a story last night.
She tells me a story last night.
She tell me a story last night.
exercises.answer: She told me a story last night.
exercises.explanation: tell 的过去式为 told。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：I ___ (find) an old notebook yesterday.
exercises.explanation: find 的过去式是 found。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：He ___ (take) the book home last night.
exercises.explanation: take 的过去式是 took。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：We ___ (have) lunch at the market yesterday.
exercises.explanation: have 的过去式是 had。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的过去式填空：She ___ (buy) a small painting last Sunday.
exercises.explanation: buy 的过去式是 bought。

title: 查清一次误会
subtitle: Did You Send the File?
theme: 一般过去时的疑问与否定
goal: 用 did + 动词原形询问过去的动作，用 did not 说明没有发生的事情。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Did you send the presentation to the whole team?
dialogue.zh: 你把演示文稿发给整个团队了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Oscar
dialogue.en: Yes, I did. I sent it before lunch.
dialogue.zh: 发了。我在午饭前发的。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I did not get it. Did you use my new email address?
dialogue.zh: 我没收到。你用的是我的新邮箱地址吗？

dialogue.speaker: Oscar
dialogue.en: Oh, no. I used the old one. I did not check the contact list.
dialogue.zh: 啊，没有。我用了旧地址。我没检查联系人名单。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: That explains it. Where did you save the final file?
dialogue.zh: 那就说得通了。你把最终文件存在哪里了？

dialogue.speaker: Oscar
dialogue.en: I saved it in the shared folder.
dialogue.zh: 我把它存进共享文件夹了。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thanks. I found it there.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我在那里找到了。

dialogue.speaker: Oscar
dialogue.en: Good. I will update your address now.
dialogue.zh: 好。我现在就更新你的地址。

vocab.example: Did you send the message?
I saved the file on my laptop.
Our team finished the work.
Please check my email address.
I did not check the list.
Her name is in my contact list.
Where did you save the photo?
The file is in this folder.

grammar.title: did 已经表示过去，后面用原形
grammar.rule: 询问一般过去时的实义动词动作，用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。否定用 did not / didn’t + 动词原形。特殊疑问词如 where、when 放在 did 前。be 动词的过去式问句仍用 was/were，不套用这个结构。
grammar.formula: Did + 主语 + 动词原形?；主语 + did not + 动词原形；Where + did + 主语 + 动词原形?

examples.en: Did you send the file?
I did not send it yesterday.
Where did she save the report?

grammar.pitfall: 不能写 Did you sent...? 或 I didn’t sent...。did 或 didn’t 后必须用 send。

patterns.en: Did you check the address?
I did not get your message.
Where did you save the file?

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的过去时问句。
exercises.explanation: did 已表示过去，send 使用动词原形。

exercises.prompt: I did not ___ the contact list yesterday.
exercises.explanation: did not 后接动词原形 check。

exercises.prompt: “Did Oscar use the new address?” 的否定简答是：
exercises.explanation: did 问句的否定简答使用 did not 或 didn’t。

exercises.prompt: Where ___ you save the final file yesterday?
exercises.explanation: 询问过去的 save 动作，使用 where did + 主语 + save。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：Did Nina ___ (find) the file?
exercises.explanation: did 后面使用 find 原形，不能用 found。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：Oscar did not ___ (use) the new address.
exercises.explanation: did not 后面用 use 原形。

exercises.prompt: 填入 do、does 或 did：When ___ you send the report yesterday?
exercises.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，提问实义动词动作使用 did。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：Did they ___ (get) your email?
exercises.explanation: did 后面用 get 原形，不能用 got。

title: 停电时发生了什么
subtitle: When the Lights Went Out
goal: 描述过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，并说明另一个短动作发生时的背景。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: What were you doing when the lights went out?
dialogue.zh: 停电时你正在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: I was cooking dinner. My sister was setting the table.
dialogue.zh: 我正在做晚饭。我妹妹正在摆餐具。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Were you using the oven?
dialogue.zh: 你当时在用烤箱吗？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: No, I was making a salad. Luckily, we had some bread.
dialogue.zh: 没有，我在做沙拉。幸好我们还有些面包。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I was walking up the stairs when it happened.
dialogue.zh: 停电时我正在上楼。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Was it very dark? Did someone help?
dialogue.zh: 当时很暗吗？有人帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Yes. A neighbour was holding a torch by the door.
dialogue.zh: 有。一位邻居正在门边举着手电筒。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: We were eating by candlelight when the power came back.
dialogue.zh: 恢复供电时，我们正借着烛光吃饭。

vocab.example: The lights went out at eight.
The bread is in the oven.
I was making a tomato salad.
She was walking up the stairs.
The hallway was dark.
He was holding a torch.
We lit a candle on the table.
The power came back after ten minutes.

grammar.title: 过去进行时：给过去的故事加上背景
grammar.rule: 过去进行时用 was/were + 动词-ing，描述过去某一时刻正在进行的动作。讲故事时，进行中的背景动作常用过去进行时，新发生的事件常用一般过去时。when 和 while 的选择取决于句意，不是只能搭配某一个时态。
grammar.formula: 主语 + was / were + 动词-ing；I was cooking when the lights went out.

examples.en: At eight, I was cooking dinner.
She was reading when the phone rang.
While we were waiting, we talked about the trip.
examples.zh: 我们等候时，聊了聊这次旅行。

grammar.pitfall: 过去进行时不能漏掉 was/were。when 后也可以出现进行时；要先分清哪个动作正在进行、哪个事件发生了。

patterns.en: What were you doing at eight?
I was cooking when the lights went out.
While we were waiting, we talked.

exercises.prompt: At eight last night, I ___ dinner.
exercises.explanation: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，用 was cooking。

exercises.prompt: My sisters ___ the table when I arrived.
exercises.explanation: sisters 为复数，过去进行时用 were setting。

exercises.prompt: I was reading when the phone ___.
exercises.explanation: 正在阅读是背景，电话响是新发生的事件，用 ring 的过去式 rang。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确问句。
exercises.explanation: 过去进行时疑问句使用 were + you + using。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：Grace ___ walking upstairs when the lights went out.
exercises.explanation: Grace 是第三人称单数，使用 was。

exercises.prompt: 填入 was 或 were：We ___ eating when the power came back.
exercises.explanation: we 搭配 were，形成过去进行时。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的 -ing 形式填空：Daniel was ___ (make) a salad.
exercises.explanation: make 去掉不发音的 e，再加 -ing。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的 -ing 形式填空：They were ___ (wait) outside at nine.
exercises.explanation: wait 的 -ing 形式是 waiting。

title: 安排一个有意义的假日
subtitle: Plans for the Long Weekend
theme: be going to 表示计划
goal: 用 be going to + 动词原形表达已经打算做的事，询问计划并说明准备。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: What are you going to do over the long weekend?
dialogue.zh: 长周末你打算做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: I am going to visit a nature park with two friends.
dialogue.zh: 我打算和两个朋友去一个自然公园。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: Are you going to camp there?
dialogue.zh: 你们打算在那里露营吗？

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: No, we are going to stay in a small guesthouse.
dialogue.zh: 不，我们打算住一家小旅馆。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: How are you going to get there?
dialogue.zh: 你们打算怎么去？

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: We are going to take a train, then walk from the station.
dialogue.zh: 我们打算先坐火车，再从车站走过去。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.en: That sounds lovely. I am going to spend the weekend learning to cook.
dialogue.zh: 听起来很棒。我打算利用这个周末学做饭。

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: Then I am going to ask you for dinner ideas when I get back!
dialogue.zh: 那我回来后就打算向你请教晚餐的点子！

vocab.example: We are going to make a plan tonight.
I enjoy spending time in nature.
The park closes at six.
We are going to camp near the lake.
They booked a room in a guesthouse.
Meet me outside the station.
We are going to spend two days there.
She is going to learn to cook.

grammar.title: be going to：已经有的计划
grammar.rule: 用 am/is/are going to + 动词原形表示打算或已经形成的计划。否定在 be 后加 not；疑问句把 be 放在主语前。该结构也可表达根据当前迹象作出的预测，例如乌云出现时说 It is going to rain。
grammar.formula: 主语 + am / is / are + going to + 动词原形

examples.en: I am going to visit a park.
We are not going to camp.
How are you going to get there?

grammar.pitfall: to 后接动词原形：going to visit，不是 going to visiting。不要漏掉 be：I going to visit 错。

patterns.en: What are you going to do this weekend?
patterns.zh: 你这个周末打算做什么？

patterns.en: We are going to stay for two nights.
How are you going to get there?

exercises.prompt: We have already made a plan. We ___ visit the park on Saturday.
exercises.explanation: we 搭配 are，完整结构是 are going to + visit。

exercises.prompt: She is going to ___ a room tonight.
exercises.explanation: going to 后接动词原形 book。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确问句。
exercises.explanation: 把 are 提到主语 you 前，后面保留 going to camp。

exercises.prompt: 根据已经安排好的周末计划，选择正确否定句。
options: We not are going to drive.
We do not going to drive.
We are not going to drive.
exercises.answer: We are not going to drive.
exercises.explanation: 否定词 not 放在 are 后面。

exercises.prompt: 描述现在的计划，be 使用一般现在时。填入 be 动词：Chen ___ going to visit a nature park.
exercises.explanation: Chen 为第三人称单数，使用 is。

exercises.prompt: 填入缺少的单词：They are going ___ take a train.
exercises.explanation: 计划结构为 be going to + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：Lily is going to ___ (learn) to cook.
exercises.explanation: going to 后用 learn 原形。

exercises.prompt: 描述现在的计划，be 使用一般现在时。填入 be 动词：How ___ you going to get to the station?
exercises.explanation: 主语 you 的 be 动词是 are。

title: 预测与可靠的承诺
subtitle: A Plan for a Rainy Day
theme: will 表示预测、承诺与即时决定
goal: 用 will / will not 表达预测、承诺和临时决定，并区分已经形成的计划。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: Do you think the outdoor concert will be busy?
dialogue.zh: 你觉得户外音乐会会有很多人吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I think it will. The band is very popular.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得会。这个乐队很受欢迎。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: I am worried about the rain.
dialogue.zh: 我担心下雨。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: If it rains, I will bring a large umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 如果下雨，我会带一把大伞。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: Thanks. Oh, my phone is still upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。啊，我的手机还在楼上。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I will get it for you. Wait here.
dialogue.zh: 我帮你拿。你在这里等。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: All right. Please do not forget the tickets.
dialogue.zh: 好。请别忘了门票。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I will not forget them. They are already in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 我不会忘的。它们已经在我的包里了。

vocab.example: The concert will start at seven.
We enjoy outdoor activities.
The band will play three new songs.
The park is popular with families.
I think it will rain tomorrow.
I will bring an umbrella.
I will not forget your birthday.
I promise I will call you.

grammar.title: will：看法、承诺和即时决定
grammar.rule: will + 动词原形常用于预测、承诺和说话时作出的决定。所有主语都用 will，否定为 will not / won’t，疑问句把 will 放到主语前。will 和 going to 的用法有重叠，应根据语境理解，不要只凭时间词判断。
grammar.formula: 主语 + will + 动词原形；主语 + will not + 动词原形；Will + 主语 + 动词原形?

examples.en: I think the concert will be busy.
examples.zh: 我觉得音乐会会很热闹。

examples.en: I will get your phone for you.
I will not forget the tickets.

grammar.pitfall: will 后没有第三人称单数 -s：She will come 正确，She will comes 错。I think 后的预测通常可用 will，但并非所有预测都只能用 will。

patterns.en: I think it will be busy.
I will help you with that.
I will not forget.

exercises.prompt: I think the concert ___ popular.
exercises.explanation: will 后接 be 原形。

exercises.prompt: 你刚看到朋友拿不动行李，当场决定帮忙。哪句话最合适？
options: I carry that bag every day.
I will carry that bag for you.
exercises.answer: I will carry that bag for you.
exercises.explanation: will 可表达说话时作出的决定或主动提供帮助。

exercises.prompt: will not 的常用缩写是：
exercises.explanation: will not 缩写为 won’t；wouldn’t 是 would not。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确问句。
options: Does she will bring an umbrella?
Will she to bring an umbrella?
exercises.explanation: will 放在主语前，动词 bring 用原形。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：He will ___ (call) you tonight.
exercises.explanation: will 后面使用动词原形 call。

exercises.prompt: 填入缺少的单词：I will ___ forget the tickets.（用完整否定形式）
exercises.explanation: will 的完整否定为 will not。

exercises.prompt: 填入 will 或 did：___ you help me tomorrow?
exercises.explanation: tomorrow 指未来；在给定的两个词中使用 will。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：I think the weather will ___ (be) better tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: will 后接 be 原形。

title: 为朋友准备晚餐
subtitle: What Is in the Kitchen?
theme: 可数与不可数名词；some / any
goal: 区分可数与不可数名词，描述食物的数量，使用 some / any 提问、否定和礼貌提供。

dialogue.speaker: Mila
dialogue.en: Let us make dinner for our friends. Do we have any rice?
dialogue.zh: 我们给朋友们做晚饭吧。我们有米吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: Yes, there is some rice in the cupboard.
dialogue.zh: 有，橱柜里有一些米。

dialogue.speaker: Mila
dialogue.en: Are there any tomatoes?
dialogue.zh: 有番茄吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: There are three tomatoes, but there is not any cheese.
dialogue.zh: 有三个番茄，但没有奶酪。

dialogue.speaker: Mila
dialogue.en: We can make tomato rice. How much water do we need?
dialogue.zh: 我们可以做番茄饭。我们需要多少水？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: Two cups for this recipe. We also need a little oil.
dialogue.zh: 按这个食谱需要两杯。我们还需要一点油。

dialogue.speaker: Mila
dialogue.en: Good. Would you like some tea before we start?
dialogue.zh: 好。开始前你想喝点茶吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: Yes, please. And I will wash the vegetables.
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢。我来洗蔬菜。

vocab.example: There is some rice in the bowl.
The cups are in the cupboard.
We need three tomatoes.
There is not any cheese.
Please add a cup of water.
This recipe is easy to follow.
Put a little oil in the pan.
We bought some fresh vegetables.

grammar.title: some / any 与名词的数量
grammar.rule: 可数名词有单复数，如 a tomato / three tomatoes；不可数名词在这里作为整体物质使用，如 rice、water、cheese。肯定句常用 some，疑问句和否定句常用 any。提供食物或提出请求、期待肯定回应时，疑问句常用 some，例如 Would you like some tea?
grammar.formula: some / any + 可数名词复数或不可数名词；How many + 可数名词复数?；How much + 不可数名词?

examples.en: There are some tomatoes.
There is not any rice.
Would you like some tea?

grammar.pitfall: 这里的 rice 和 water 不直接加复数 -s。用 a cup of water、two bags of rice 等容器或单位表达数量。餐厅中 two waters 可指两份水，是语境中的省略用法。

patterns.en: Do we have any rice?
How much water do we need?
Would you like some tea?

exercises.prompt: 在描述食材总量时，哪一个通常是不可数名词？
exercises.explanation: rice 作为米这种物质时通常不可数；其余三项可以按个计数。

exercises.prompt: There is not ___ cheese in the fridge.
exercises.explanation: 否定句中的不可数名词 cheese 可用 any 修饰。

exercises.prompt: 你正在礼貌地向客人提供茶，最自然的表达是：
options: Would you like a tea leaves?
exercises.explanation: 主动提供茶时，常用 Would you like some tea?。

exercises.prompt: How ___ tomatoes do we need?
exercises.explanation: tomatoes 是可数名词复数，询问数量用 how many。

exercises.prompt: 填入 much 或 many：How ___ water do we need?
exercises.explanation: water 在这里不可数，用 how much。

exercises.prompt: 填入 much 或 many：How ___ eggs are in the box?
exercises.explanation: eggs 为可数名词复数，用 how many。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内名词的复数填空：We need three ___ (tomato).
exercises.explanation: tomato 的复数为 tomatoes，词尾加 -es。

exercises.prompt: 填入 is 或 are：There ___ some rice in the cupboard.
exercises.explanation: rice 在这里为不可数名词，there be 结构使用 is。

title: 比较两种通勤方式
subtitle: A Better Way to Work
goal: 用比较级 + than 比较两个选择，并从时间、费用与舒适度解释选择。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: Are you taking the bus to the office now?
dialogue.zh: 你现在坐公共汽车去办公室吗？

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.en: Yes. It is cheaper than the train.
dialogue.zh: 是的。它比火车便宜。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: But is it slower?
dialogue.zh: 但它是不是更慢？

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.en: A little. The train takes twenty minutes, and the bus takes thirty.
dialogue.zh: 慢一点。火车要二十分钟，公共汽车要三十分钟。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I find the train more comfortable during quiet hours.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得在不拥挤的时段，火车坐起来更舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.en: True, but the bus stop is closer to my flat.
dialogue.zh: 确实，但公共汽车站离我的公寓更近。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: So the bus is a better choice for you?
dialogue.zh: 所以对你来说，公共汽车是更好的选择？

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.en: Usually. On busy mornings, cycling is faster than both.
dialogue.zh: 通常是。早高峰的时候，骑车比这两种都快。

vocab.example: The bus is cheaper than the train.
This service is slower at weekends.
Cycling is faster on this route.
This seat is more comfortable.
The station is close to my flat.
Walking is a good choice today.
The road is busier in the morning.
This route is shorter.

grammar.title: 比较级：两个对象怎么比
grammar.rule: 短形容词通常加 -er，如 slow → slower；以 e 结尾加 -r，如 close → closer；辅音字母 + y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -er，如 busy → busier。较长形容词通常用 more + 形容词，如 more comfortable。good 的比较级是 better。
grammar.formula: A + be + 形容词比较级 + than + B；more + 长形容词；good → better

examples.en: The bus is cheaper than the train.
This chair is more comfortable than that one.
examples.zh: 这把椅子比那把更舒服。

examples.en: The road is busier on Monday.

grammar.pitfall: 不要双重比较：more cheaper 错，应为 cheaper；more better 错，应为 better。比较连接词是 than，不是 then。

patterns.en: It is cheaper than the train.
Which route is faster?
This is a better choice for me.
patterns.zh: 对我来说，这是更好的选择。

exercises.prompt: The bus is ___ than the train.
exercises.explanation: 两个对象比较用 cheaper，不能再加 more。

exercises.prompt: This seat is ___ than that one.
exercises.explanation: comfortable 是较长的形容词，比较级用 more comfortable。

exercises.prompt: good 的比较级是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: good 的比较级为 better，最高级为 best。

exercises.prompt: The road is ___ in the morning than at noon.
exercises.explanation: busy 的 y 前为辅音，变 y 为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的比较级填空：This route is ___ (short) than the other one.
exercises.explanation: short 直接加 -er，得到 shorter。

exercises.prompt: 填入 than 或 then：Cycling is faster ___ walking.
exercises.explanation: 比较级后连接比较对象用 than。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的比较级填空：The bus stop is ___ (close) than the station.
exercises.explanation: close 以 e 结尾，比较级只加 -r。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的比较级填空：This map is ___ (good) than the old one.
exercises.explanation: good 的比较级是 better。

title: 选出最适合的旅程
subtitle: Choosing the Right Trip
goal: 在三个或以上选项中使用最高级，结合价格、时间和个人需要解释决定。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: We have three possible trips. Which one do you prefer?
dialogue.zh: 我们有三个旅行方案。你更喜欢哪一个？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: The mountain trip has the best views, but it is the most expensive.
dialogue.zh: 山区之旅景色最好，但它最贵。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: The coastal town is the nearest place. It is only an hour away.
dialogue.zh: 海边小镇最近。只需要一小时。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: And the forest trip is the cheapest. We can bring our own lunch.
dialogue.zh: 森林之旅最便宜。我们可以自己带午餐。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: Which trip is the easiest for everyone in the group?
dialogue.zh: 哪一个方案对团队里的每个人都最方便？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Probably the coast. The path is flat, and there are plenty of places to rest.
dialogue.zh: 可能是海边。那里的小路平坦，而且有很多可以休息的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: Then the nearest option may be the best one for us.
dialogue.zh: 那么最近的方案可能最适合我们。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Agreed. The longest journey does not always make the best holiday.
dialogue.zh: 同意。路途最远的不一定就是最好的假期。

vocab.example: We walked near the mountain.
The room has a lovely view.
We are going to the coast.
The forest path is quiet.
The journey takes an hour.
There are six people in our group.
The path is flat and easy to walk on.
We stopped for a short rest.

grammar.title: 最高级：在一个范围内选出最……
grammar.rule: 在一个明确范围内比较三个或以上对象，常用最高级。短形容词通常加 -est；辅音字母 + y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -est，如 easy → easiest；较长形容词常用 most + 形容词。good 的最高级为 best。最高级形容词前通常用 the；有 my、our 等限定词时不再加 the。
grammar.formula: the + 形容词最高级 + in / of ...；the most + 长形容词；good → best

examples.en: This is the cheapest of the three trips.
examples.zh: 这是三个旅行方案中最便宜的。

examples.en: It is the most comfortable room in the hotel.
examples.zh: 这是酒店里最舒适的房间。

examples.en: That was my best holiday.
examples.zh: 那是我最棒的一次假期。

grammar.pitfall: 比较两个时通常用比较级，明确比较三个或以上时用最高级。不能写 the most cheapest；应为 the cheapest。my best friend 前不用再加 the。

patterns.en: Which is the cheapest option?
This is the best choice for our group.
patterns.zh: 这是最适合我们团队的选择。

patterns.en: It is the most convenient place to meet.
patterns.zh: 这是最方便的见面地点。

exercises.prompt: 在三个方案中选最便宜的：The forest trip is ___ of the three.
exercises.explanation: 范围是三个方案，使用最高级 the cheapest。

exercises.prompt: The mountain trip is ___ option on the list.
exercises.explanation: expensive 为较长形容词，最高级用 the most expensive。

exercises.prompt: good 的最高级是哪一个？
exercises.explanation: good → better → best。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确句子。
options: This was my the best holiday.
This was my most best holiday.
exercises.explanation: 已有 my 限定名词，不再加 the；best 不与 most 重复。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的最高级填空：This is the ___ (long) journey of the three.
exercises.explanation: long 的最高级为 longest。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的最高级填空：The coast is the ___ (near) destination on our list.
exercises.explanation: near 的最高级为 nearest。

exercises.prompt: 用括号内形容词的最高级填空：This is the ___ (easy) route in the park.
exercises.explanation: easy 的 y 前为辅音，变 y 为 i，再加 -est。

exercises.prompt: 填入 more 或 most：It is the ___ comfortable room in this hotel.
exercises.explanation: 比较酒店内所有房间，构成最高级 the most comfortable。

title: 聊聊你做过的事
subtitle: Experiences worth sharing
goal: 用现在完成时询问和描述截至目前的人生经历，并自然追问具体细节。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Have you ever travelled alone?
dialogue.zh: 你曾经独自旅行过吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes, I have. I have visited two cities on my own.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我独自去过两个城市。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Have you tried any unusual food on your trips?
dialogue.zh: 你在旅途中尝过什么不常见的食物吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I have tried seaweed soup, but I have never eaten insects.
dialogue.zh: 我喝过海藻汤，但从来没有吃过昆虫。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I have never stayed in a hostel. What is it like?
dialogue.zh: 我从来没有住过青年旅舍。感觉怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I have met some friendly people in hostels. The shared rooms can be noisy, though.
dialogue.zh: 我在青年旅舍遇到过一些友好的人。不过，共用房间可能会很吵。

vocab.example: Travelling alone was a useful experience.
I hope to study abroad one day.
The hostel has a shared kitchen.
We tried an unusual vegetable dish.
She enjoys travelling alone.
Have you ever taken a night train?
I have never missed a flight.
We visit our cousins every summer.

grammar.title: 现在完成时：截至目前的经历
grammar.rule: 用 have/has + 过去分词谈截至现在做过或没做过的事。ever 常用于询问“曾经”，never 自带否定意思。这里不交代已经结束的具体时间；追问某次经历的时间通常转用一般过去时。
grammar.formula: 肯定：主语 + have/has + 过去分词；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 过去分词…?；否定经历：主语 + have/has + never + 过去分词。

examples.en: I have visited a science museum.
Has she ever travelled abroad?
We have never eaten here before.
examples.zh: 我们以前从来没有在这里吃过饭。

grammar.pitfall: 不要说 I have never went；go 的过去分词是 gone。说“去过且已回来”通常用 have been to；have gone to 通常表示去了、尚未回来。

patterns.en: Have you ever tried a new sport?
patterns.zh: 你曾经尝试过一项新运动吗？

patterns.en: I have never done that before.
patterns.zh: 我以前从来没有做过那件事。

patterns.en: I have been to that city twice.

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的经历问句：___ you ever visited an island?
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时疑问句用 Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词；you 对应 have。

exercises.prompt: She has never ___ a horse.
exercises.explanation: has 后接过去分词；ride–rode–ridden。

exercises.prompt: “我去过首尔，现在已经回来了”应选哪句？
exercises.explanation: have been to 表示去过某地、现已回来；have gone to 通常表示去了、还没回来。

exercises.prompt: 哪句适合泛问对方截至目前的人生经历？
options: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
Has you ever climbed a mountain?
exercises.answer: Have you ever climbed a mountain?
exercises.explanation: 主语 you 用 have，动词 climb 用过去分词 climbed，ever 表示曾经。

exercises.prompt: 按提示填一个词：Have you ___ tried camping?（曾经）
exercises.explanation: 询问截至现在是否曾经做过某事，常在主语后、过去分词前使用 ever。

exercises.prompt: 用 eat 的过去分词填空：I have never ___ this fruit.
exercises.explanation: eat 的变化为 eat–ate–eaten；have 后必须使用过去分词。

exercises.prompt: 填入现在完成时助动词：My sister ___ visited this museum twice.
exercises.explanation: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，所以现在完成时用 has。

exercises.prompt: 用 see 的过去分词填空：We have ___ this film before.
exercises.explanation: see 的变化为 see–saw–seen。

title: 说清一件事持续了多久
subtitle: From then until now
goal: 区分 since 的起点与 for 的时长，用现在完成时描述持续到现在的状态。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: How long have you lived in this neighbourhood?
dialogue.zh: 你在这个社区住了多久？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I have lived here for three years.
dialogue.zh: 我在这里住了三年。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Have you worked at the library since you moved here?
dialogue.zh: 你从搬来这里以后就一直在图书馆工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: No, I have worked there since January. Before that, I worked in a shop.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我从一月份起在那里工作。在那之前，我在商店工作。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: I have known my neighbours for a long time, but I still forget their dog’s name.
dialogue.zh: 我认识邻居很久了，但我还是会忘记他们家狗的名字。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I have had the same problem since I met them!
dialogue.zh: 我从认识他们起就有同样的问题！

vocab.example: Our neighbourhood has a small park.
I have lived here since May.
We have waited for twenty minutes.
The area has changed recently.
He is a member of the reading group.
Our neighbour grows flowers.
They own a small bookshop.
The local library closes at six.

grammar.title: since 与 for：从过去持续到现在
grammar.rule: since 后接起点，例如 Monday、2022 或一个一般过去时从句；for 后接一段时长，例如 two weeks。描述持续到现在的居住、认识、拥有等情况时，可用现在完成时。since/for 本身不决定时态，是否持续到现在才是关键。
grammar.formula: have/has + 过去分词 + since + 起点；have/has + 过去分词 + for + 时长；How long + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词…?

examples.en: I have known her for five years.
He has lived here since 2021.
examples.zh: 他从 2021 年起就住在这里。

examples.en: We have been friends since we started school.
examples.zh: 我们从开始上学起就是朋友。

grammar.pitfall: know 是状态动词，此处用 have known，不用 have been knowing。“结婚十年了”用 have been married for ten years，不用 have married for ten years。

patterns.en: How long have you lived here?
I have worked here since last summer.
patterns.zh: 我从去年夏天起就在这里工作。

patterns.en: We have known each other for years.
patterns.zh: 我们认识彼此很多年了。

exercises.prompt: I have lived here ___ 2022.
exercises.explanation: 2022 是开始的时间点，持续到现在的状态用 since + 起点。

exercises.prompt: She has owned this bike ___ six months.
exercises.explanation: six months 是一段时长，因此用 for。

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确描述“我认识她两年了，而且现在仍认识她”？
options: I have known her for two years.
I know her since two years.
I have been knowing her for two years.
I have knew her for two years.
exercises.answer: I have known her for two years.
exercises.explanation: know 是状态动词，使用 have known；two years 是时长，用 for。

exercises.prompt: We have been friends since we ___ at college.
exercises.explanation: since 从句在这里交代过去的开始事件，使用一般过去时 met。

exercises.prompt: 在 since / for 中填一个：I have had this laptop ___ three years.
exercises.explanation: three years 表示持续的时长，用 for。

exercises.prompt: 在 since / for 中填一个：They have lived here ___ last April.
exercises.explanation: last April 是起点，用 since。

exercises.prompt: 用 know 的过去分词填空：I have ___ my teacher for a year.
exercises.explanation: know–knew–known；持续至今的认识用 have known。

exercises.prompt: 补全询问持续时间的问句：How ___ have you worked here?
exercises.explanation: How long 用来询问持续多长时间。

title: 把经历和具体故事接起来
subtitle: An experience, then a story
goal: 区分现在完成时与一般过去时，先介绍经历，再说已结束的具体事件。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: Have you ever taken part in a city clean-up?
dialogue.zh: 你曾经参加过城市清洁活动吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, I have. I joined one last Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 参加过。我上周六参加了一次。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: Where did you meet the other volunteers?
dialogue.zh: 你在哪里与其他志愿者集合的？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: We met outside the station at nine, and then we cleaned the river path.
dialogue.zh: 我们九点在车站外集合，然后清理了河边的小路。

dialogue.speaker: Eva
dialogue.en: Have you signed up for another event?
dialogue.zh: 你报名参加另一次活动了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, I have already booked a place. Last time, I learnt how much waste a small group can collect.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我已经报名了。上一次，我了解到一小群人能收集多少垃圾。

vocab.example: A volunteer showed us where to meet.
The event starts at ten.
I have already sent the form.

vocab.meaning: 还；已经（常用于否定句和疑问句）
vocab.example: Have you finished yet?
We discussed a recent trip.
The group collected plastic bottles.
Please put food waste in this bin.
You need to book a place online.

grammar.title: 现在完成时与一般过去时
grammar.rule: 现在完成时把过去与现在联系起来，常用于不说明具体过去时间的经历或当前结果。一般过去时讲已结束时间内的事件，常和 yesterday、last week、in 2020 等连用。讲故事时可以先用现在完成时引出经历，再用一般过去时交代细节。
grammar.formula: 经历或当前结果：have/has + 过去分词；已结束的过去事件：动词过去式；过去问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形…?

examples.en: I have visited the island.
I visited it last year.
Have you finished the report yet?

grammar.pitfall: 不要说 I have visited it yesterday；yesterday 是已结束的具体过去时间，用 I visited it yesterday。did 后动词用原形，如 Where did you go?

patterns.en: Have you ever volunteered?
I tried it for the first time last year.
patterns.zh: 我去年第一次尝试了它。

patterns.en: What did you learn from the experience?
patterns.zh: 你从那次经历中学到了什么？

exercises.prompt: We ___ the museum yesterday.
exercises.explanation: yesterday 是已结束的过去时间，应使用一般过去时 visited。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的过去问句。
exercises.explanation: did 已经表示过去，后面的实义动词用原形 go。

exercises.prompt: “她已经寄出表格了”，强调现在已完成，选哪句？
options: She has already send the form.
She has already sent the form.
She have already sent the form.
exercises.answer: She has already sent the form.
exercises.explanation: 主语 she 用 has，send 的过去分词是 sent；already 常放在助动词后。

exercises.prompt: 哪组问答中的时态搭配正确？
options: Have you ever camped? Yes, I have camped yesterday.
Did you go last night? Yes, I have go.
Have you ever camped? Yes, I camped last month.
Have she visited? Yes, she did.
exercises.answer: Have you ever camped? Yes, I camped last month.
exercises.explanation: 先用现在完成时询问经历，再用一般过去时说明已结束的具体时间。

exercises.prompt: 用 go 的过去式填空：We ___ to the exhibition last Sunday.
exercises.explanation: last Sunday 表示已结束的过去时间，go 的过去式是 went。

exercises.prompt: 用 finish 的过去分词填空：I have already ___ my homework.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时使用 have + 过去分词；finish 的过去分词是 finished。

exercises.prompt: 填一个助动词：When ___ you arrive yesterday?
exercises.explanation: yesterday 指过去，特殊疑问句使用 When did + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 填入表示“还”的词：I haven’t received the email ___.
exercises.explanation: yet 常放在现在完成时否定句末尾，表示到现在还没有。

title: 分清必须、不必和禁止
subtitle: Rules and responsibilities
theme: 学习中心规则与日常责任
goal: 用 must 与 have to 表示义务，尤其分清 mustn’t 的禁止和 don’t have to 的不必要。

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: Do I have to bring my student card every time?
dialogue.zh: 我每次都必须带学生证吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Yes, you do. You must show it at the front desk.
dialogue.zh: 是的。你必须在前台出示学生证。

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: Do I have to book a seat in advance?
dialogue.zh: 我必须提前预订座位吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: No, you don’t have to book an ordinary seat, but you have to reserve a group room.
dialogue.zh: 普通座位不必预订，但小组自习室必须预约。

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: Can I make phone calls in the reading area?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在阅读区打电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: No, you mustn’t make calls there. You can use the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 不可以，你不能在那里打电话。你可以去大厅。

vocab.example: Please read the rules before you enter.
You need permission to enter this room.
We reserved a room for our study group.
A photo is required for the card.
The extra reading is optional.
This is a quiet study area.
I will wait in the lobby.
Keeping the room clean is everyone’s responsibility.

grammar.title: must / have to：义务与限制
grammar.rule: must 和 have to 都可表示必须。have to 常用于说明实际要求；must 常见于规则、强烈要求，两者并非绝对按“主观/客观”划分。mustn’t 表示禁止；don’t/doesn’t have to 表示没必要，不禁止。表示过去的必须通常用 had to。
grammar.formula: must + 动词原形；have/has to + 动词原形；mustn’t + 动词原形（禁止）；don’t/doesn’t have to + 动词原形（不必）；had to + 动词原形（过去义务）。

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt.
She has to work on Saturday.
You don’t have to print the ticket.
You mustn’t park here.

grammar.pitfall: mustn’t 不等于“不必”。You mustn’t leave 表示你不准离开；You don’t have to leave 表示你不必离开。must 后面不加 to。

patterns.en: Do I have to bring anything?
You don’t have to book in advance.
Visitors mustn’t enter this area.
patterns.zh: 访客不得进入这个区域。

exercises.prompt: “报名不是强制的，你可以选择不报名”：You ___ register.
exercises.explanation: 不必须、不需要用 don’t have to；mustn’t 则是禁止报名。

exercises.prompt: “这里严禁吸烟”：You ___ smoke here.
exercises.explanation: 明确的禁止用 mustn’t + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: She ___ show her ID before entering.
exercises.explanation: 第三人称单数 she 对应 has to。

exercises.prompt: 昨天火车取消了，我们只好乘公共汽车：We ___ take a bus yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 过去发生的必要行为通常用 had to + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 填入一般现在时助动词：___ I have to pay now?
exercises.explanation: have to 的一般现在时疑问句使用 do/does；主语 I 用 do。

exercises.prompt: 用 have 的一般现在时形式填空：He ___ to wear a uniform at work.
exercises.explanation: 第三人称单数 he 后使用 has to。

exercises.prompt: 用 have 的过去式填空：Last night, we ___ to leave early.
exercises.explanation: 过去的必须用 had to。

exercises.prompt: 补全固定结构：You must ___ the rules.（使用 follow 的适当形式）
exercises.explanation: 情态动词 must 后直接接动词原形 follow，不加 to。

title: 把建议说得有用又礼貌
subtitle: Advice that helps
goal: 用 should/shouldn’t 提建议，并以具体理由和可执行的小步骤支持建议。

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.en: I keep forgetting new words. What should I do?
dialogue.zh: 我总是忘记新单词。我该怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: You should review a few words every day and use them in sentences.
dialogue.zh: 你应该每天复习几个单词，并把它们用在句子里。

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.en: Should I learn fifty new words each evening?
dialogue.zh: 我应该每天晚上学五十个新单词吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: You shouldn’t choose a number that you cannot maintain. Start with a smaller set.
dialogue.zh: 你不应该选择一个你无法坚持的数量。先从少一点开始。

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.en: I also get nervous when I speak.
dialogue.zh: 我说话时还会紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: You should practise short answers aloud. You don’t need to speak perfectly to make progress.
dialogue.zh: 你应该大声练习简短回答。你不需要说得完美才能取得进步。

vocab.example: Could you give me some advice?
I review my notes after class.
Reading before bed is a useful habit.
I feel nervous before a presentation.
We practise speaking regularly.
You have made good progress.
Choose a manageable daily goal.
Read the sentence aloud.

grammar.title: should：提出建议
grammar.rule: should + 动词原形表示建议或通常认为应做的事；shouldn’t 表示建议不要。疑问句把 should 放在主语前。建议可以加 because 解释原因。这里的 should 是建议，不像规则中的 must 那样表示强制要求。
grammar.formula: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形；Should + 主语 + 动词原形…?；What should + 主语 + do?

examples.en: You should take a short break.
You shouldn’t study all night.
Should I check my answers now?
examples.zh: 我现在应该检查答案吗？

grammar.pitfall: 不要说 should to practise 或 should practises；should 后接原形 practise。advice 不可数，使用 some advice 或 a piece of advice，不用 an advice。

patterns.en: What should I do first?
You should try a shorter practice session.
patterns.zh: 你应该尝试一次更短的练习。

patterns.en: You shouldn’t worry about every small mistake.
patterns.zh: 你不应该为每个小错误担心。

exercises.prompt: You should ___ your notes after class.
exercises.explanation: should 是情态动词，后接动词原形 review。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的建议问句。
exercises.explanation: should 疑问句结构是 Should + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: You are very tired. You ___ study until three in the morning.
exercises.explanation: 根据疲劳的语境，应建议不要熬夜，用 shouldn’t + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 哪个表达中的 advice 用法正确？
exercises.explanation: advice 是不可数名词，可以用 a piece of advice 表示一条建议。

exercises.prompt: 填入表示“应该”的情态动词：You ___ check your spelling.
exercises.explanation: should + 动词原形用于给出建议。

exercises.prompt: 用 take 的适当形式填空：She should ___ a short break.
exercises.explanation: 无论主语人称是什么，should 后都接动词原形 take。

exercises.prompt: 补全询问建议的句子：What should I ___ next?（做）
exercises.explanation: What should I do…? 是询问接下来应该做什么的常用结构。

exercises.prompt: 用 piece 的适当形式补全“一条建议”：Can you give me a ___ of advice?
exercises.explanation: 一条建议用 a piece of advice；advice 本身不用复数。

title: 表达太多、太少与足够
subtitle: Finding the right balance
goal: 掌握 too + 形容词、形容词 + enough 和 enough + 名词，解释实际限制。

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: This evening class looks interesting. Shall we join it?
dialogue.zh: 这个晚间课程看起来很有趣。我们要报名吗？

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: It finishes too late for me. I have to get up early.
dialogue.zh: 对我来说它结束得太晚了。我得早起。

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: What about the online course? Is your internet connection fast enough?
dialogue.zh: 那线上课程怎么样？你的网络速度够快吗？

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Yes, but I don’t have enough time for four lessons a week.
dialogue.zh: 够快，但我没有足够时间每周上四节课。

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: There is a weekend option with two lessons.
dialogue.zh: 有一个每周上两节课的周末选项。

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: That sounds manageable. It leaves enough time to review what we learn.
dialogue.zh: 那听起来可以应付。它能留出足够时间复习我们所学的内容。

vocab.example: I need a better balance between work and study.
We have enough chairs for everyone.
The internet connection is slow today.
An online class is another option.
A smaller room is available.
We are looking for an affordable course.
The bus is crowded in the morning.
This book is suitable for beginners.

grammar.title: too 与 enough：超出需要和达到需要
grammar.rule: too + 形容词/副词表示程度过高，往往带来问题；形容词/副词 + enough 表示程度足够；enough + 名词表示数量足够。too much 修饰不可数名词，too many 修饰可数名词复数。
grammar.formula: too + 形容词 + to do；形容词 + enough + to do；enough + 名词；too much + 不可数名词；too many + 可数名词复数。

examples.en: The bag is too heavy to carry.
The room is large enough for six people.
examples.zh: 这个房间够大，能容纳六个人。

examples.en: We have enough time to practise.

grammar.pitfall: enough 的位置取决于修饰对象：fast enough，但 enough time。too 并不只是 very 的替代词；too expensive 暗示贵到不合适，very expensive 只强调价格高。

patterns.en: It is too late to start now.
Is the explanation clear enough?
I don’t have enough time today.

exercises.prompt: The screen is not big ___ for everyone to read.
exercises.explanation: enough 修饰形容词时放在形容词之后：big enough。

exercises.prompt: We have ___ chairs for all the guests.
exercises.explanation: enough 直接放在名词前，表示数量足够。

exercises.prompt: There are too ___ people in this small room.
exercises.explanation: people 是复数概念，too many 用于可数名词复数。

exercises.prompt: “咖啡太烫，现在喝不了”选哪句？
options: The coffee is hot enough drink now.
The coffee is too hot to drink now.
The coffee is enough hot to drink now.
The coffee is too hot drinking now.
exercises.answer: The coffee is too hot to drink now.
