exercises.explanation: too + 形容词 + to do 表示太……以至于不能……。

exercises.prompt: 填入 too 或 enough：The table is ___ heavy for me to lift.
exercises.explanation: too heavy 表示重到超出我能搬动的程度。

exercises.prompt: 填入 too 或 enough：She speaks clearly ___ for us to understand.
exercises.explanation: enough 修饰副词时放在副词之后，clearly enough 表示足够清楚。

exercises.prompt: 填入 much 或 many：I have too ___ homework tonight.
exercises.explanation: homework 是不可数名词，用 too much。

exercises.prompt: 填一个词补全不定式：The box is light enough ___ carry.
exercises.explanation: 形容词 + enough + to do，表示足够……可以做某事。

title: 说出目标与行动目的
subtitle: What do you want to achieve?
goal: 用 want to / plan to 表达目标，用 to + 动词原形解释采取行动的目的。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: What do you want to improve this month?
dialogue.zh: 这个月你想提高什么？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I want to speak more confidently in meetings.
dialogue.zh: 我想在会议上更自信地表达。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: What do you plan to do?
dialogue.zh: 你打算做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I plan to record short answers to check my pronunciation.
dialogue.zh: 我打算录下简短回答，以检查自己的发音。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: I go to a conversation group to practise listening to different people.
dialogue.zh: 我去参加会话小组，以练习听懂不同人的表达。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: That sounds useful. I would like to join you next week.
dialogue.zh: 那听起来很有用。我想下周和你一起去。

vocab.example: Set one clear goal for this week.
She worked steadily to achieve her goal.
I want to improve my listening.
He answered the question confidently.
What is the purpose of this activity?
I use a dictionary to check pronunciation.
We plan to meet on Friday.
Can I record my answer on my phone?

grammar.title: to do：想做什么与为何行动
grammar.rule: want、plan、hope 等动词后可接 to + 动词原形。would like to 是较礼貌的“想要做”。独立的 to do 短语还可以说明目的，回答“为了什么”；目的短语的行动者通常与主句主语相同。
grammar.formula: want/plan/hope + to + 动词原形；would like + to + 动词原形；主语 + 动作 + to + 动词原形（目的）。

examples.en: I want to improve my English.
She visits the library to use the quiet study room.
examples.zh: 她去图书馆，为了使用安静的自习室。

examples.en: We would like to ask a question.

grammar.pitfall: want 后接另一个动词时，在本课结构中需要 to：want to learn。说明目的用 to practise，不用 for practise；for 后若接动名词，表达的结构和用途并不相同。

patterns.en: I want to get better at speaking.
I use short recordings to check my progress.
patterns.zh: 我用简短录音检查自己的进步。

patterns.en: I would like to try that activity.

exercises.prompt: I want ___ a new skill.
exercises.explanation: want 后接 to + 动词原形，表示想做某事。

exercises.prompt: She went to the library ___ a book.
exercises.explanation: to borrow 说明去图书馆的目的。

exercises.prompt: 哪句较礼貌地表达“我想问一个问题”？
options: I would like ask a question.
I would like to ask a question.
I would to ask a question.
I like to asked a question.
exercises.answer: I would like to ask a question.
exercises.explanation: would like to + 动词原形是礼貌表达愿望的常见结构。

exercises.prompt: “We practise together to build confidence.”中 to build confidence 的作用是什么？
exercises.explanation: to do 短语可以回答为什么采取前面的行动。

exercises.prompt: 补全结构：They plan ___ start a reading group.
exercises.explanation: plan to + 动词原形，表示打算做某事。

exercises.prompt: 用 improve 的适当形式填空：I listen to short recordings to ___ my listening.
exercises.explanation: 表示目的的 to 后接动词原形 improve。

exercises.prompt: 用 like 的适当形式补全礼貌表达：I would ___ to join the class.
exercises.explanation: would like to 表示想要做某事。

exercises.prompt: 用 visit 的适当形式填空：We hope to ___ the science centre.
exercises.explanation: hope to + 动词原形，visit 保持原形。

title: 谈爱好，也谈坚持练习
subtitle: Enjoying the learning process
goal: 正确使用 enjoy / practise / finish 后的动名词，并自然介绍爱好和学习习惯。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: What do you enjoy doing after work?
dialogue.zh: 你下班后喜欢做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: I enjoy cooking, especially trying recipes from other countries.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其喜欢尝试其他国家的食谱。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Do you like watching cooking videos in English?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢看英语烹饪视频吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Yes. I pause the video and practise describing each step.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢。我会暂停视频，练习描述每一步。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I enjoy reading short reviews, but I avoid looking up every word.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢读简短评论，但我会避免逐个查每一个词。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: That makes sense. After I finish watching, I explain the recipe in my own words.
dialogue.zh: 有道理。看完之后，我会用自己的话解释食谱。

vocab.example: I enjoy learning with a friend.
Try to avoid rushing your answer.
This recipe uses only five ingredients.
Can you describe your neighbourhood?
Pause the recording after each sentence.
I finish work at six.
We practise speaking every day.
Music is one of my main interests.

grammar.title: 动名词：动词的 -ing 形式作宾语
grammar.rule: enjoy、avoid、finish、practise 后若跟另一个动词，通常使用 -ing 形式。本课用 like doing 表达一般喜好；like to do 也可以正确，不能把 like 一概归为只能跟 -ing。介词后接动词时通常也用 -ing，例如 interested in learning。
grammar.formula: enjoy/avoid/finish/practise + doing；like + doing（也可用 to do）；be interested in + doing。

examples.en: I enjoy walking by the river.
She practises speaking every morning.
They are interested in learning a new language.
examples.zh: 他们对学习一门新语言感兴趣。

grammar.pitfall: 不要说 enjoy to read；应说 enjoy reading。-ing 拼写需注意：make → making，run → running。英式英语中 practise 是动词，practice 是名词。

patterns.en: I enjoy learning about different cultures.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。

patterns.en: I am interested in trying something new.
patterns.zh: 我对尝试新事物感兴趣。

patterns.en: I practise describing ordinary things.

exercises.prompt: She enjoys ___ short stories.
exercises.explanation: enjoy 后接动词时使用 -ing 形式。

exercises.prompt: I finished ___ the form.
exercises.explanation: finish 后接动名词 completing。

exercises.prompt: 关于 like，哪项说法正确？
options: like 后永远只能接过去式
like reading 和 like to read 都可以正确
exercises.answer: like reading 和 like to read 都可以正确
exercises.explanation: like 可以接动名词，也可以接不定式；具体语境下侧重点可能不同。

exercises.prompt: We are interested in ___ a local club.
exercises.explanation: in 是介词，后接动词时用 -ing 形式。

exercises.prompt: 用 cook 的 -ing 形式填空：I enjoy ___ at home.
exercises.explanation: enjoy 后接 cooking，表示喜欢做饭。

exercises.prompt: 用 make 的 -ing 形式填空：She enjoys ___ short videos.
exercises.explanation: make 末尾不发音的 e 去掉后加 -ing，成为 making。

exercises.prompt: 用 speak 的 -ing 形式填空：We practise ___ in pairs.
exercises.explanation: practise 后接动名词 speaking。

exercises.prompt: 用 run 的 -ing 形式填空：He avoids ___ on busy roads.
exercises.explanation: run 的 -ing 形式双写末尾 n：running。

title: 把理由、结果和让步串起来
subtitle: Making your answer flow
goal: 用 because、so、although 组织有逻辑的回答，清楚区分原因、结果和出乎预期的情况。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Would you prefer to live near your office?
dialogue.zh: 你更愿意住在办公室附近吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.en: Yes, because I could spend less time travelling.
dialogue.zh: 愿意，因为我可以少花一些时间通勤。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: The city centre is expensive, so some people choose the suburbs.
dialogue.zh: 市中心很贵，所以有些人选择郊区。

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.en: Although my flat is small, it is close to a station. That matters to me.
dialogue.zh: 虽然我的公寓很小，但它离车站很近。这对我很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I like my area because there are several parks nearby.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢我住的地区，因为附近有几个公园。

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.en: It sounds pleasant. Although we value different things, we both want a convenient home.
dialogue.zh: 听起来很宜人。虽然我们看重的东西不同，但我们都想住得方便。

vocab.example: There are two reasons for my choice.
The result was better than we expected.
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the walk.
I stayed home because I was tired.
The location is convenient for work.
They moved to a quiet suburb.
I prefer small shops to large malls.
There is a bus stop nearby.

grammar.title: because / so / although：连接完整想法
grammar.rule: because 引出原因；so 引出结果；although 引出让步，表示尽管有某情况，另一情况仍成立。although 或 because 从句放在句首时，通常在从句后加逗号。标准书面英语中，避免用 because…so… 或 although…but… 同时连接同一对分句。
grammar.formula: 结果 + because + 原因；原因, so + 结果；Although + 让步情况, + 主句。

examples.en: I walk to work because it is nearby.
examples.zh: 我走路上班，因为工作地点很近。

examples.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
examples.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一班。

examples.en: Although the room is small, it gets plenty of light.
examples.zh: 虽然房间小，但采光很好。

grammar.pitfall: 不要把中文“虽然……但是……”逐字套成 Although…, but…。可以用 Although it is small, I like it，或 It is small, but I like it。because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或名词短语。

patterns.en: I prefer this option because it saves time.
patterns.zh: 我更喜欢这个选择，因为它节省时间。

patterns.en: It was raining, so we stayed inside.
patterns.zh: 当时在下雨，所以我们待在室内。

patterns.en: Although it costs more, it is more convenient.

exercises.prompt: I stayed at home ___ I felt unwell.
exercises.explanation: 后半句解释待在家的原因，使用 because。

exercises.prompt: The train was cancelled, ___ we took a bus.
exercises.explanation: 后半句是火车取消带来的结果，因此用 so。

exercises.prompt: 哪句符合本课的标准书面表达？
options: Although it was cold, but we went outside.
Because it was cold, so we stayed inside.
Although cold it, we went outside.
Although it was cold, we went outside.
exercises.answer: Although it was cold, we went outside.
exercises.explanation: although 已经引导让步从句，不再用 but 连接同一个主句。

exercises.prompt: The match was cancelled because ___ heavy rain.
exercises.explanation: because of 后接名词短语 heavy rain；because 后通常接完整从句。

exercises.prompt: 在 because / so / although 中填入表示原因的词：I chose this class ___ it fits my schedule.
exercises.explanation: because 引导原因从句。

exercises.prompt: 在 because / so / although 中填入表示结果的词：I missed the bus, ___ I walked home.
exercises.explanation: so 连接前面的原因和后面的结果。

exercises.prompt: 在 because / so / although 中填入表示让步的词：___ the task was difficult, we finished it.
exercises.explanation: although 引导让步从句，句首首字母大写。

exercises.prompt: 补全固定表达：We arrived late because ___ the traffic.
exercises.explanation: the traffic 是名词短语，所以用 because of。

title: 谈规律，也谈下一步可能性
subtitle: If this happens, what comes next?
goal: 区分表示一般规律的零条件句和表示真实未来可能的第一条件句。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: What happens if you study with your phone beside you?
dialogue.zh: 如果手机放在身边学习，会怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: If I leave it on my desk, I check it too often.
dialogue.zh: 如果我把它放在桌上，我就会过于频繁地查看它。

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: I have the same habit. If I need to concentrate, I put mine in another room.
dialogue.zh: 我有同样的习惯。如果我需要集中注意力，就把手机放到另一个房间。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Will you join the study group tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 你明天会参加学习小组吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sofia
dialogue.en: If I finish work on time, I will join you at seven.
dialogue.zh: 如果我按时下班，我会在七点加入你们。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Great. If the library is full, we will meet at the café next door.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。如果图书馆满了，我们就在隔壁咖啡馆集合。

vocab.example: You can join on one condition: arrive on time.
I find it easier to concentrate in a quiet room.
Phone notifications distract me.
Small changes can produce a useful result.
A short meeting is possible tomorrow.
I will walk unless it rains.
I prepare my bag before bed.
Leave now; otherwise, you will be late.

grammar.title: 零条件句与第一条件句
grammar.rule: 零条件句常用一般现在时 + 一般现在时，描述一般规律或反复出现的习惯。第一条件句常用 if + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形，描述真实可能的未来情况。这里讲最常用的基础结构；主句也可以按语境使用 can 等情态动词或祈使句。
grammar.formula: 零条件句：If + 一般现在时, + 一般现在时；第一条件句：If + 一般现在时, + will + 动词原形。

examples.en: If I skip breakfast, I feel hungry before lunch.
examples.zh: 如果我不吃早饭，午饭前就会饿。

examples.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we will walk to the park.
examples.zh: 如果明天天气好，我们会走去公园。

examples.en: I will call you if the meeting ends early.
examples.zh: 如果会议提前结束，我会给你打电话。

grammar.pitfall: 在本课表示未来条件的 if 从句中通常不用 will：说 If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside。if 从句置于主句前时通常加逗号，置于主句后通常不加。

patterns.en: If I have time, I usually read.
patterns.zh: 如果有时间，我通常会阅读。

patterns.en: If I finish early, I will join you.
patterns.zh: 如果我提前完成，就会加入你们。

patterns.en: What will you do if it rains?

exercises.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay inside.
exercises.explanation: 第一条件句中，if 从句通常用一般现在时表示未来条件。

exercises.prompt: If I finish early, I ___ you this evening.
exercises.explanation: 这里讨论今晚真实可能发生的事情，主句用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 哪句描述通常反复出现的习惯？
options: If I go to bed late, I feel tired the next morning.
If I finish tomorrow, I will call you.
I am going to call you tonight.
exercises.answer: If I go to bed late, I feel tired the next morning.
exercises.explanation: 两个分句都用一般现在时，描述常见的条件与结果。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的第一条件句。
options: If she will arrives early, we start nine.
If she arrives early, we will start at nine.
If she arrive early, we will starts.
If she arriving early, we started tomorrow.
exercises.answer: If she arrives early, we will start at nine.
exercises.explanation: if 从句中 she 用 arrives；主句 will 后用原形 start。

exercises.prompt: 用 be 的适当形式填空：If the library ___ closed tomorrow, we will meet online.
exercises.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时；主语 the library 是单数，be 变为 is。

exercises.prompt: 填入将来时助动词：If I have time tonight, I ___ review this lesson.
exercises.explanation: 主句用 will + 动词原形，表达未来条件成立后的行动。

exercises.prompt: 用 feel 的一般现在时形式填空：If I miss lunch, I usually ___ hungry by three.
exercises.explanation: 这是通常发生的习惯，主句用一般现在时；主语 I 使用 feel。

exercises.prompt: 用 finish 的适当形式填空：If she ___ work early tomorrow, she will come.
exercises.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时，第三人称单数 she 后为 finishes。

title: 用从句把人和事说明白
subtitle: Which person? Which thing?
goal: 用 who、which、that 构成基础限制性定语从句，补充识别人物或事物所需的信息。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I need an app that helps me organise new words.
dialogue.zh: 我需要一个能帮助我整理新单词的应用。

dialogue.speaker: Luke
dialogue.en: Try the one that our teacher recommended.
dialogue.zh: 试试我们老师推荐的那个。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: Is she the teacher who runs the conversation club?
dialogue.zh: 她是负责会话俱乐部的那位老师吗？

dialogue.speaker: Luke
dialogue.en: Yes. She is also the person who designed our weekly practice sheets.
dialogue.zh: 是的。她也是设计我们每周练习单的人。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I like tools which let me add my own examples.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢能让我添加自己例句的工具。

dialogue.speaker: Luke
dialogue.en: Then this one may suit you. The examples that you create yourself are often easier to remember.
dialogue.zh: 那这个可能适合你。自己造的例句通常更容易记住。

vocab.example: Can you recommend a useful dictionary?
I organise my notes by topic.
She designed a simple study timetable.
A notebook is a useful learning tool.
Write one example for each new word.
This detail helps me understand the story.
The name helps us identify the correct file.
The library offers free learning resources.

grammar.title: 限制性定语从句：who / which / that
grammar.rule: 定语从句紧接被描述的名词，帮助说明“哪个人或哪件事”。在本课不加逗号的限制性定语从句中，who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。关系代词在从句中作主语时不能省略；作宾语时通常可以省略。
grammar.formula: 人 + who/that + 从句；事物 + which/that + 从句；a teacher who helps us；a book that I bought。

examples.en: She is the teacher who helps us with writing.
examples.zh: 她就是帮助我们练习写作的那位老师。

examples.en: This is an app that saves my notes.
examples.zh: 这是一个保存我笔记的应用。

examples.en: The book that I borrowed is useful.

grammar.pitfall: 关系代词已经在从句中作主语或宾语时，不要再加重复代词：说 the teacher who helps me，不说 who she helps me；说 the book that I bought，不说 that I bought it。

patterns.en: I need a tool that saves time.
patterns.zh: 我需要一个节省时间的工具。

patterns.en: She is the person who helped me.
This is the book that I told you about.
patterns.zh: 这就是我跟你提到的那本书。

exercises.prompt: The woman ___ teaches our class is very patient.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 the woman 指人，关系代词 who 在从句中作主语。

exercises.prompt: I use a dictionary ___ gives clear examples.
exercises.explanation: 先行词 a dictionary 指物，可用 which 或 that；此题选项中只有 which 符合。

exercises.prompt: 哪句没有重复使用代词？
options: The book that I bought it is useful.
The book that I bought is useful.
The teacher who she helps us is kind.
The app which it saves notes is free.
exercises.answer: The book that I bought is useful.
exercises.explanation: that 已作 bought 的宾语，不能再加 it；who/which 作主语时也不能再加 she/it。

exercises.prompt: 在不加逗号的限制性定语从句中，that 可以指什么？
exercises.explanation: 本课的限制性定语从句中，that 可以指人或事物。非限制性定语从句有不同规则。

exercises.prompt: 在 who / which 中填一个：I know a student ___ speaks three languages.
exercises.explanation: who 指代人 a student，并在定语从句中作主语。

exercises.prompt: 在 who / which 中填一个：This is a website ___ offers short exercises.
exercises.explanation: which 指代事物 a website，并在定语从句中作主语。

exercises.prompt: 用 help 的一般现在时形式填空：She is the teacher who ___ me every week.
exercises.explanation: 关系代词 who 指代单数 the teacher，所以从句谓语用 helps。

exercises.prompt: 用 give 的一般现在时形式填空：I like books that ___ clear examples.
exercises.explanation: that 指代复数 books，从句谓语用 give，不加 -s。

title: 解释流程，完成一次综合表达
subtitle: From everyday English to clear explanations
goal: 用一般现在时和一般过去时的被动语态说明流程，并整合经历、条件、逻辑与描述结构。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: Have you ever volunteered at a repair café?
dialogue.zh: 你曾经在维修咖啡馆做过志愿者吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: Yes, I helped at one last month. Broken items are checked by volunteers before any work begins.
dialogue.zh: 做过，我上个月在一家帮过忙。维修开始前，损坏的物品会由志愿者检查。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: What happened to the lamp that you brought?
dialogue.zh: 你带去的那盏灯后来怎么样了？

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: It was repaired in an hour. The cable was replaced, so I didn’t have to buy a new lamp.
dialogue.zh: 它一小时内就修好了。电线被换掉了，所以我不必买新灯。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: I would like to join because I enjoy learning practical skills.
dialogue.zh: 我想参加，因为我喜欢学习实用技能。

dialogue.speaker: Jon
dialogue.en: If you come next Saturday, we will show you how the items are recorded. You should book a place first.
dialogue.zh: 如果你下周六来，我们会向你展示物品是如何登记的。你应该先预约一个名额。

vocab.example: They repair small electrical items.
The process has three main steps.
We need to replace the broken part.
Please check the address carefully.
Write your name on each item.
The cable is damaged.
The course teaches practical skills.
We recycle paper and glass.

grammar.title: 基础被动语态：把承受动作的人或物放到前面
grammar.rule: 当重点是动作的承受者，或者执行者不重要、未知时，可用被动语态。一般现在时被动用 am/is/are + 过去分词；一般过去时被动用 was/were + 过去分词。需要说明执行者时用 by。只有能带宾语的相应用法才能构成这类被动结构。
grammar.formula: 现在：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词；过去：主语 + was/were + 过去分词；执行者：by + 人或机构。

examples.en: The rooms are cleaned every morning.
examples.zh: 这些房间每天早晨打扫。

examples.en: My bike was repaired yesterday.
examples.zh: 我的自行车昨天修好了。

examples.en: The event is organised by local volunteers.
examples.zh: 这项活动由当地志愿者组织。

grammar.pitfall: 不能只用 be + 动词原形：应说 is checked，不是 is check。注意主语单复数：The item is checked / The items are checked。不要把 I am interested 一概当作动作被动；过去分词也可作形容词。

patterns.en: The items are checked before repair.
patterns.zh: 物品在维修前会接受检查。

patterns.en: It was repaired by a local volunteer.
patterns.zh: 它是由一名当地志愿者修好的。

patterns.en: If we reuse more things, we will produce less waste.
patterns.zh: 如果我们重复使用更多东西，就会产生更少废物。

exercises.prompt: These forms ___ every Monday.
exercises.explanation: forms 是复数，习惯性流程用一般现在时被动 are + checked。

exercises.prompt: My bicycle ___ yesterday.
exercises.explanation: yesterday 表示过去；bicycle 是单数，用 was + 过去分词 repaired。

exercises.prompt: 复习：If I ___ time tomorrow, I will join the workshop.
exercises.explanation: 第一条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时，主语 I 后用 have。

exercises.prompt: 复习：哪句同时正确表达经历和已结束的具体事件？
options: I have volunteered last month. I help yesterday.
I has volunteered before. I helped last month.
I have volunteer before. I have helped yesterday.
I have volunteered before. I helped at a café last month.
exercises.answer: I have volunteered before. I helped at a café last month.
exercises.explanation: 第一句用现在完成时表达经历；第二句有 last month，使用一般过去时。

exercises.prompt: 用 be 的一般现在时形式填空：The equipment ___ checked every morning.
exercises.explanation: equipment 是不可数名词，作单数处理；一般现在时被动用 is checked。

exercises.prompt: 用 write 的过去分词填空：The report was ___ by our team.
exercises.explanation: write–wrote–written；过去被动用 was + written。

exercises.prompt: 补全说明执行者的介词：The class is taught ___ a local teacher.
exercises.explanation: 被动语态中，by 用来引出动作的执行者。

exercises.prompt: 复习：用 learn 的 -ing 形式填空：I enjoy ___ practical skills.
exercises.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 learning。
